chapters.title: Chapter 1701: Fortune’s Call 2
paragraphs: "You seemed like someone who wasn't interested in conversation just now."
"I am not."
Nux was honest.
"What a coincidence. I am the same.
I do not wish to talk to you.
Leave."
"I didn't know I needed to cater to you in order to get a mission."
Nux frowned.
According to the Skeleton's memories, this woman simply handed the 'special' missions to whoever came to her.
"You don't.
You just aren't eligible to take the special missions."
"Why?" Nux frowned.
"Go to the enquiry counter if you have any queries."
The woman shrugged, pointing towards a different counter without even looking at Nux.
Nux stood in silence.
However, the woman had had enough.
"Leave, you are blocking the line." Exclusive content from freewebnovel
"There is no one else besides me standing her-"
Nux wanted to say it, soon, however, he sensed around 3 beings standing behind him. He turned around and frowned.

The three of them weren't here just now, Nux actually saw them drinking at a different table when he entered, even now, when they stood behind him, it didn't seem like they were here to get a mission.
However, before Nux could say anything,
"Leave, unlike you, I am eligible for special missions."
The man standing in front smiled widely, looking at Nux with a face full of mockery, the two standing behind him were the same.

The three of them seemed related to each other, at the very least, they were of the same race. Their faces resembled a lion, they had a muscular frame, and a red body. They looked like close-distance warriors.
"Indeed, don't block the line."
"Tsk, newbies these days. Can't believe they move around so oblivious to their surroundings."
"I guess that is what happens when you have too much free time on your hands."
The three started laughing.
It wasn't just them, some others were the same. They seemed to be enjoying the show.
Nux's frown deepened.
He could sense that these people were targeting him intentionally.
Honestly, he was very much capable of getting rid of them now...
However...
He didn't want to cause a scene in this place, the people here weren't a problem, however...
Nux glanced above.
He could sense several strong auras above.
'Primordials.'
And unlike the Primordial he faced back in that Lowest Level World, all of them were strong, even stronger than Primordials back in Yrniel.
Nux wasn't sure he could defeat them even if he fought them in a one-on-one battle and if all of them jumped at him together...
Even escaping would be difficult.
So although there was no rule here that said you couldn't fight inside, he wanted to avoid commotion.
'Let's meet outside.'
He decided, remembering the faces of the three who stood behind him.
As he left, the first in line walked towards the counter, leaned forward towards the woman's desk and,
"I saved you there, didn't I?"
"What? Do you want me to thank you then?"
"Would you rather continue talking with that one then?" The man laughed.
"Alright alright, I give up.
Thank you for coming and saving me from being affected by the lord of boredom, my brave hero~"
The woman spoke dramatically.
The two standing behind the man laughed, the man shook his head as well.
"Anyways, what are you doing this evening?"
"Hmm? Are you hitting on me?"
"Depends.
Do you like it?"
The conversation continued and Nux, who was listening to everything felt his mouth twitching.
'And I have too much free time on my hands?'
Soon, however, he calmed himself and decided to walk towards the counter the woman pointed at. He wouldn't be here for long anyway; nothing here should affect him.

Thinking about that, Nux glanced at the man sitting at the counter, unlike most men here, this one had a slender physique and a clean face. Honestly, he didn't even look like he could fight. He looked like someone most people would pick on.
Of course, since Nux wasn't interested in knowing if that was true or not, he just walked towards him, wanting to know how one can get special missions.

From the Skeleton's memories, he only knew that the woman in that counter gave special missions, he didn't know how he would become eligible for one. After all, the Skeleton himself never did a special mission. They were known for being dangerous.
The man, who saw Nux walking towards him sighed.
He had overheard the conversation just now so he could tell what sort of person Nux was, and just like the woman, he wasn't thrilled to talk to him.

Of course, this didn't mean he could just ignore him. He had to do what he was paid for, therefore, he prepared himself and nodded his head at Nux as a form of greeting, but suddenly, Nux paused and then,
He turned around and left the building.
The man sitting behind the counter felt his mouth twitching. The people around him who noticed what happened couldn't help but laugh.
"He's an interesting one, that's for sure."
Another man sitting behind the counter next to him commented.
"I hope I don't have to see his face again." The man who was 'ignored' by Nux replied.
"Don't worry, ones with attitude like that usually don't last long." His friend replied and the man nodded, forgetting about Nux after cursing him a few more times.
On the other hand, Nux, who just left a building walked into another building and rushed towards the counter.
"How can I-"
"I need a room."
Before the person could finish, Nux demanded as he placed 8 coins on the table.
These coins were the currency here, he got them from the ones Skeleton and his friends.
"A-Alright. Room 206 is available."
Seeing that the man seemed to know the price of rooms, he simply gave him the keys and as if he knew where the said room was, Nux took the keys, walked towards the room and the moment he entered,
"What is it?"
He questioned.
'Riona moved.
She should be waking up pretty soon.'
He heard the words he wanted to hear the most.

chapters.title: Chapter 1702: So give me my Nux back.
paragraphs: 'Riona moved.
She should be waking up pretty soon.'
The instant Nux heard those words, he felt his entire body shudder.
Without waiting for even a single moment, he went inside his Shadow.
Or at least that's what he wanted to do but before he could, a tall figure jumped out of his shadow, jumping right on top of him, making the two of them fall on the bed.
"Ah!"
Nux was taken aback.
"Fel, what are you doing?"
Seeing the woman laying on top of him, he questioned with a frown. His hands automatically moved towards her butts.
Felberta didn't say anything, she just continued to stay where she was, pressing Nux under her big body.
"I think I told you not to come out."
Nux frowned.
"You did."
Felberta nodded, pressing her body even more.
"But I didn't listen."
Hearing those words, Nux's frown deepened.

Then suddenly, with both her hands on either side of his head, Felberta rose up. Her tempting breasts hanging down, of course, everything was covered with the gown she was wearing, but clothes weren't able to hide that sinful body.
Not to mention the expression Felberta currently had on her face made everything she did a little too effective.
"What are you going to do now that I am here despite you telling me not to?
Are you going to punish me?"
Felberta questioned, her face flushed, her eyes drunk and her smile making it clear that she was expecting something.
"Felberta...
It is not your turn yet.
Others won't stay still if you play around like that."
"And so what? Just this one time, they can all join, I won't mind."
Felberta replied.
Nux's frown deepened.
"What? Scared?"
Felberta teased.
But then suddenly,
Her expression changed, the tipsy look on her face disappeared as if it never existed and with a neutral look on her face, the first wife looked into Nux's eyes and,
"Or are you worried?"
"What are yo-"
Nux wanted to say something, but suddenly, Felberta placed her finger on his lips as she then closed the distance between their faces.
Her long hair falling down and touching Nux made this scene too alluring, Nux froze, looking into Felberta's eyes like a prey who now had no way out.
Felberta continued to move forward, slowly, she lowered her forehead and placed it on Nux's.
The two closed their eyes.
And then,
"Nothing's changed, Nux."
Felberta spoke lightly.
Nux's eyes twitched, his brows furrowed, Felberta however, continued,
"Everything's the same.
There is a strong entity after us, stronger than anything we have faced before.
Our family member was attacked,
The threat is still there because we are not strong enough to deal with it, yet."
Felberta focused on the last word more.
"From Ricardus, the King of the Skyfall Kingdom,
To Arcturus, the Dragon Lord who attacked us directly,
Our opponents were always stronger than us."
Felberta then moved, kissing Nux's nose before moving her lips slowly gliding towards Nux's ear,
"But we still won.
You still won.
No matter the odds, we were never defeated and we never will be."
"What are you trying to say?" Nux, who opened his eyes was having a hard time understanding what Felberta was trying to get at by bringing all of this out of the blue.
"I am saying the same things.
Nothing has changed, the situation we are in isn't any different than anything we have faced before, everything is the same,
So you don't need to be different either."
Felberta looked into her husband's eyes as she said those words.
Hearing those words, Nux momentarily paused and then, the realization dawned in.
All this while, even though his body was reacting to Felberta's touch and had pretty much given in, letting the woman do whatever she wanted to him, the logical side of his mind was confused.
'How is she here? And how was she able to come alone?'
Nux knew his wives well. He refused to believe that they would let Felberta come and do something like this, especially when it wasn't her turn. Don't miss chapters on freewebnovel
He was honestly expecting others to appear and stop her, crying about how unfair it was and everything, but even after all this time passed, no one appeared.
It shocked him and it was only now that was he able to understand.
"So they sent you.
I thought you somehow overpowered them all."
Nux laughed as he closed his eyes.
"I would have done that if that is what it took."
Felberta chuckled.
"You think you can overpower all of them?
Vyriana is still there, you know?
And now she's even stronger since her Bloodline is now at the same level as that of a being from the Middle-Level World."
"That is what I am trying to say,
We are getting stronger at a rate a lot faster than anyone could even think of.
There is nothing to worry about."
Felberta replied confidently.
"We are up against an entire Universe, Fel."
"And?
We ARE an entire Universe.
A battle between two Universes,
Sounds fun~"
"Riona got hurt."
"And we destroyed a few worlds the 'enemy' liked so much."
"Those worlds are replicable,
Riona isn't."
Nux narrowed his eyes.
He didn't like how Felberta was equating Riona getting hurt to some Worlds being devoured. There was nothing in his eyes that could be equated to his wives getting hurt.
"That is why she is alive."
Felberta however, didn't back down.
She then gently cupped Nux's cheek and,
"Because of those eyes you currently have, eyes filled with worry and love, we are sure that nothing is going to happen to us.
Even if the enemy is the Universe, we will win.
So stop trying to blame yourself and acting on your own.
You need to calm down Nux.
You need to return back to how you normally were.
I, no, we need you to return back to the playful Nux you always were.
Although I do like the serious Nux as well,"
Felberta suddenly squinted her nose and,
"This one just isn't the same."
Then suddenly, Felberta grabbed Nux's collar, pulled him close to her and,
"So give me my Nux back."

chapters.title: Chapter 1703: Riona’s back
paragraphs: "So give me my Nux back."
Felberta spoke, looking into Nux's eyes, her beautiful eyes shining intensely, almost as if they wanted to hypnotise Nux.
Nux didn't move.
He found himself lost in his wife's eyes, her words resonating in his head, then suddenly,
"Hmm? Looks like she is awake."
Felberta suddenly commented.
Nux's expression changed, quickly realizing what she meant, he glanced at the woman on top of him.
"What are you waiting for?"
Felberta chuckled.
Nux's smile widened, then, Felberta left his collar, he fell down and suddenly, his body fell into his Shadow.
Felberta, who was left alone inside the room smiled lightly, then, she jumped into Nux's shadow that seemed to be waiting for him and disappeared right after her.
"You are awake!"
Inside Nux's Universe, Riona, who had just woken up, was suddenly hugged by a being so fast that she didn't even realize what happened.
The only thing she could sense was the strong sense of comfort that washed over her entire body.
The woman closed her eyes, not saying anything, hugging the being back unconsciously.

Slowly, her mind started working, recalling everything that led to this moment, how she sensed the love of her life was about to lose his life, how she was suddenly teleported to that place, protecting her husband and how the impact was too strong for her to handle and how she passed out.
As she recalled everything, Riona sensed Nux, who was hugging him as tightly as he could, tremble constantly.
Right now...
He looked so... weak.
A weak smile appeared on Riona's face as well. She didn't know exactly how much time had passed, however, she did know that it was a lot.
Before she passed out, she could sense the scale of the attack she had blocked and the impact it had on her body, it wasn't something that she could recover from in just a few years.
Decades must have passed.
Riona knew it and because of that, the woman could easily guess what her husband must be feeling.
Seeing his trembling body was proof of that.
Riona gulped weakly as she tightened her hug around Nux. Her action made Nux's body shudder, so Riona gently moved her hand around his back.
Telling him that she was here, telling him that she was fine.
However, what Riona didn't know was that Nux didn't just spend decades...
The man used the energy of the worlds inside his Universe to rebuild his brain and entered deep inside his consciousness, a place where time didn't flow...
That was the place he spent those 'decades'.
He didn't just spend decades...
He spent a long long time, time he couldn't even keep track of.
Sure, he was sorting out the information he had received while he was doing that...
But considering Nux's personality, was it possible for someone like him to forget about what happened to his wife?
It was not.

For all that time he had spent inside that space, he constantly thought about her and blamed himself for not being able to protect her, and this time... the one who was hurt wasn't just an illusion, it was his real wife.
This was also the reason why Nux seemed... much weaker than expected.
It was something his wives noticed as well. Find new chapters on freewebnovel

Sure, when he was with his wives, everything was fine, suppressing what he felt and calming his heart was possible, however, the moment he was left alone or if things didn't go like he expected them to,
Nux lost his control.
There were countless examples of it,
Lashing out at Lyriana and even that encounter with the woman behind the counter, everything showed just how weak Nux had gotten.
Sure, he seemed more mature after absorbing all the information perfectly, he was also much more powerful than before since he now knew about his powers better,
However, his mind was weak.
It was... breaking apart.
And the wives, who noticed that, decided that they had to do something.
So, they sent Felberta.
The First Wife.
And Felberta, who was watching this scene, suddenly clapped after letting Nux hug Riona for 10 whole minutes,
"Alright alright,
Are you going to just keep hugging her?
She woke up after a hundred years, a lot has happened, are you not going to get her up to date?"
Then suddenly, a perverted smile appeared on Felberta's face and,
"And I am sure her body's cravings are through the roof since it has been so long. You hugging her so compassionately isn't helping either."
*Clap* *Clap* *Clap*
"So shoo shoo,
Get up and be on the move,
You have a wife to satisfy.
Make sure she doesn't feel that she missed out.
Get on with it,
We don't have a lot of time,
There are others waiting in line."
Felberta spoke as she glanced at the other women inside the Universe.
Hearing her words, the rest of the women frowned.
This wasn't something they planned.

Nux was in a hurry, he wanted to devour more worlds, create diversions, form a connection with all his wives, help Lyriana and Eisheth, then the Foxes, he had a lot of things to do, this was the reason none of the women pressured him to spend time with them when he returned.
Only Eisheth got her chance since it was her first time, sure, Aisha got into the fun as well, but the women didn't mind, as long as Nux was happy, everything was alright.
Honestly, the women had already prepared themselves to participate in a War and not think about those things for a while.
But Felberta, who saw Nux's condition, made a decision in his stead.
Yes, this was her grand solution.
Since everything was going so fast, she wanted to slow it down, she wanted Nux to take rest.
'Felbe-'
Suddenly, Nux tried to talk to Felberta using their connection, but,
'Don't.'
Felberta stopped him.
'Eisheth and Lyriana are holding on just fine, they are still considered young for Divine Stage, they have a few thousand years in their hands.

The Universe isn't targeting us anytime soon, if it wanted to, it would have done it a long time ago, since it isn't doing anything, it means it is waiting, so as long as we don't move, it won't either.
The Foxes have been holding on for tens of thousands of years, I am sure a few more years won't make a difference either.
There is no need to rush.
Nux Leander,
Your wives are craving attention,
And this matter of utmost importance is something you need to deal with urgently.'
Felberta declared, her tone leaving no room for denial.
Nux had no choice but to give in.
And because of that,
It started.
Years of debauchery, years of doing... nothing, years of Nux not thinking about anything and just spending time with his wives.
Years of... Nux Leander healing.

Nux's smile widened, then, Felberta left his collar, he fell down and suddenly, his body fell into his Shadow.
Felberta, who was left alone inside the room smiled lightly, then, she jumped into Nux's shadow that seemed to be waiting for him and disappeared right after her.
"You are awake!"
Inside Nux's Universe, Riona, who had just woken up, was suddenly hugged by a being so fast that she didn't even realize what happened.
The only thing she could sense was the strong sense of comfort that washed over her entire body.
The woman closed her eyes, not saying anything, hugging the being back unconsciously.

Slowly, her mind started working, recalling everything that led to this moment, how she sensed the love of her life was about to lose his life, how she was suddenly teleported to that place, protecting her husband and how the impact was too strong for her to handle and how she passed out.
As she recalled everything, Riona sensed Nux, who was hugging him as tightly as he could, tremble constantly.
Right now...
He looked so... weak.
A weak smile appeared on Riona's face as well.
She didn't know exactly how much time had passed, however, she did know that it was a lot.
Before she passed out, she could sense the scale of the attack she had blocked and the impact it had on her body, it wasn't something that she could recover from in just a few years.
Decades must have passed.
Riona knew it and because of that, the woman could easily guess what her husband must be feeling.
Seeing his trembling body was proof of that.
Riona gulped weakly as she tightened her hug around Nux.
Her action made Nux's body shudder, so Riona gently moved her hand around his back.
Telling him that she was here, telling him that she was fine.
However, what Riona didn't know was that Nux didn't just spend decades...
The man used the energy of the worlds inside his Universe to rebuild his brain and entered deep inside his consciousness, a place where time didn't flow...
That was the place he spent those 'decades'.
He didn't just spend decades...
He spent a long long time, time he couldn't even keep track of.
Sure, he was sorting out the information he had received while he was doing that...
But considering Nux's personality, was it possible for someone like him to forget about what happened to his wife?
It was not.

For all that time he had spent inside that space, he constantly thought about her and blamed himself for not being able to protect her, and this time... the one who was hurt wasn't just an illusion, it was his real wife.
This was also the reason why Nux seemed... much weaker than expected.
It was something his wives noticed as well.
Find new chapters on freewebnovel

Sure, when he was with his wives, everything was fine, suppressing what he felt and calming his heart was possible, however, the moment he was left alone or if things didn't go like he expected them to,
Nux lost his control.
There were countless examples of it,
Lashing out at Lyriana and even that encounter with the woman behind the counter, everything showed just how weak Nux had gotten.
Sure, he seemed more mature after absorbing all the information perfectly, he was also much more powerful than before since he now knew about his powers better,
However, his mind was weak.
It was... breaking apart.
And the wives, who noticed that, decided that they had to do something.
So, they sent Felberta.
The First Wife.
And Felberta, who was watching this scene, suddenly clapped after letting Nux hug Riona for 10 whole minutes,
"Alright alright,
Are you going to just keep hugging her?
She woke up after a hundred years, a lot has happened, are you not going to get her up to date?"
Then suddenly, a perverted smile appeared on Felberta's face and,
"And I am sure her body's cravings are through the roof since it has been so long.
You hugging her so compassionately isn't helping either."
*Clap* *Clap* *Clap*
"So shoo shoo,
Get up and be on the move,
You have a wife to satisfy.
Make sure she doesn't feel that she missed out.
Get on with it,
We don't have a lot of time,
There are others waiting in line."
Felberta spoke as she glanced at the other women inside the Universe.
Hearing her words, the rest of the women frowned.
This wasn't something they planned.

Nux was in a hurry, he wanted to devour more worlds, create diversions, form a connection with all his wives, help Lyriana and Eisheth, then the Foxes, he had a lot of things to do, this was the reason none of the women pressured him to spend time with them when he returned.
Only Eisheth got her chance since it was her first time, sure, Aisha got into the fun as well, but the women didn't mind, as long as Nux was happy, everything was alright.
Honestly, the women had already prepared themselves to participate in a War and not think about those things for a while.
But Felberta, who saw Nux's condition, made a decision in his stead.
Yes, this was her grand solution.
Since everything was going so fast, she wanted to slow it down, she wanted Nux to take rest.
'Felbe-'
Suddenly, Nux tried to talk to Felberta using their connection, but,
'Don't.'
Felberta stopped him.
'Eisheth and Lyriana are holding on just fine, they are still considered young for Divine Stage, they have a few thousand years in their hands.

The Universe isn't targeting us anytime soon, if it wanted to, it would have done it a long time ago, since it isn't doing anything, it means it is waiting, so as long as we don't move, it won't either.
The Foxes have been holding on for tens of thousands of years, I am sure a few more years won't make a difference either.
There is no need to rush.
Nux Leander,
Your wives are craving attention,
And this matter of utmost importance is something you need to deal with urgently.'
Felberta declared, her tone leaving no room for denial.
Nux had no choice but to give in.
And because of that,
It started.
Years of debauchery, years of doing... nothing, years of Nux not thinking about anything and just spending time with his wives.
Years of...
Nux Leander healing.

chapters.title: Chapter 1704 Lyriana and Eisheth
paragraphs: *Knock* *Knock* While Lyriana was sitting inside her room, she suddenly heard a knock. Frowning, she turned towards the door, extended her senses to see who it was and as if she already sensed what she was doing, the woman outside questioned with a light smile, "Mind if I come in?" She didn't know why she was here, honestly, if it was before, she would be glad that someone else was in the same situation as her, but imagine her surprise when she realized that Eisheth Lust had become Eisheth Leander as well. She was one of 'them'.

And after what happened in the Cosmocraft, Lyriana, who realized the difference between a Leander and other women around him, decided to maintain some distance from them. No, she wasn't disappointed because of what happened. It was something obvious. It made complete sense that he would prioritize his wives first, not to mention that right now, she was no different than a liability. Sure, she was their 'party member', but when it came down to it, she was different from them.
Therefore, Lyriana didn't wish to get too attached. She was here to get stronger with Nux's help and later help him out in his journey to return the favour.

It was a pure transaction, and she would keep it that way. However, since the Succubus Queen was already was, she couldn't exactly send her away. "Come in," Lyriana answered. The woman outside opened the door and walked in. "It has been a while." She greeted. "What is it?" Lyriana questioned. "Hmm? Nothing, I was just bored." The Succubus Queen replied. Lyriana frowned. She and Eisheth weren't exactly close to each other, sure, they were acquainted, but for the woman to come here because she was 'bored', Lyriana didn't believe in. Unable to think of a reason why she would be here, Lyriana continued to stare at the woman in front of her. Eisheth didn't mind and walked towards her, sitting on the bed as she made herself comfortable.

There was a silence in the room for a while, Lyriana, who couldn't take it anymore, narrowed her eyes. "If you are going to sit silent, you could have done so inside your room." "Didn't I say it just now? I came here because I was bored, I needed company." "I don't think I am that good of a company." "It is okay, you would do just fine." Eisheth shrugged. "There are so many women here, even your daughter is here, so why are you bothering me."

"Not everyone, some have left since that woman is back," Eisheth replied. "Who is back?" Lyriana frowned. "Riona." "Riona?" Of course, Lyriana knew who the woman was. She was one of Nux's wives and Amaya's mother. "What do you mean she is bac-" Suddenly, the woman paused as she realized something, all this while, she hadn't seen a few of Nux's wives, two of them to be more precise. Lane and Riona. She had spent a few years in ExceedoGenesis, living together with all the women, however, in all those years, she never once saw any of them. Even some women like Amaya, Felberta, Evane and Vyriana disappeared somewhere from time to time, especially Amaya, in all those years, she had barely seen Amaya like 10 times.

With a frown on her face, Lyriana questioned, "Had she gone somewhere? Where did she come back from?" "I do not know the exact details but from what I know, she was hurt when Nux and all the girls left Yrniel previously and has been unconscious since then." "What..." Lyriana widened her eyes in shock. The last time Nux and the women left Yrniel... Lyriana knew that it happened more than 100 years ago, it was after Nux came to her with his offer. Wait...
If Riona was unconscious since then...

"She was unconscious for 100 years!?" Lyriana exclaimed. "Mhm." "How? What happened?" Lyriana questioned. She had been with the women when they were sparing with each other, they had seen just how monstrous all of them were, pretty much any one of them was now strong enough to take over all of Yrniel unless the Order was involved.

For one of those women to be hurt to the point that she was unconscious for 100 years... and that was when they had Healers from the Order available to help them anytime they wanted, Healers known to be able to Heal anyone back to full health if they are not dead...

Just what could possibly hurt one of them? "As I said, I do not know the details, I just know she was hurt and passed out because her body couldn't take the impact and needed time to Heal." Eisheth replied.

She remembered talking about it with her daughter, Aisha however, avoided most of her questions. She honestly felt quite left out since she was the only one who didn't know the details, but for now, she didn't complain. She just wanted everyone to be fine. "What about Lane? I haven't seen her in a while either. Where is she?" Lyriana questioned.

Most of the time, she wouldn't notice Lane's absence since the woman usually stayed in Nux's shadow most of the time, but to not see her once in 100 years... especially after knowing about Riona, Lyriana had to question. "She is inside Nux's shadow." Eisheth replied with a grim look on her face. Unlike Riona's, Lane's story she knew to a certain extent. "For 100 years...?" Lyriana frowned. "She cannot leave." Eisheth replied. "What...?"

"She is being targeted, the moment she leaves Nux's Shadow, the enemy will be able to sense her." "She cannot leave because the enemy...?" Lyriana couldn't believe it. If Nux and others were being like this, it meant the enemy was strong...

Strong enough to even suppress a monster like Nux. 'Nux, he...' Lyriana's body trembled. She had spent quite a lot of time together with Nux, she knew what sort of man she was. He challenged the Dragon Lord because he harmed his wife...
That man was outright crazy for his woman. And right now...
When one of his wives was hurt, the other was living in hiding...
That man... wasn't able to do anything...
'And this has been going on for more than 100 years...'

chapters.title: Chapter 1705 Like Mother like Daughter.
paragraphs: 'And this has been going on for more than 100 years...' Lyriana trembled as she remembered the words she said before, 'How do I know that you are not fooling me? It won't be the first time you did it. Maybe you do not have a way to make me stronger and are just buying time until you do.' To think she would say those things when his mind is already pressured by an enemy who is after him and his wife...

Lyriana wasn't a fool. She knew helping her wasn't easy. She was already recognized by the Universe. In the Universe's eyes, she was an insignificant Incomplete Divine without a Law, her potential was severely limited. What she wanted Nux to do was to somehow help her rebuild her foundation, turning her from an Incomplete Divine to a Complete one, and that too, giving her a chance to form a Law. She was pretty much asking for a second life. What she wanted was even possible! It was an absurd request that anyone else would not only decline but would also call her crazy for expecting something like it. But...
Not only did that man accept her request without judging her, he even returned with a method. 'I am not going back on my word, I am simply saying it would take time.'

He said it would take time, he said he cannot help her right now and it all made sense now. Even if there was a method, that method was something that went against the Universe, the entire Universe would be in chaos if he used that method. How much attention would he attract if he pulled something like that? Even if she knew next to nothing about the World beyond Yrniel and how Outer Space worked, Lyriana could guess that the answer was a lot of it. Especially that being who was strong enough to hurt Riona and force Lane into hiding all when Nux was with them, There was a high chance Nux would attract that being's attention if he did what she wanted...
What Lyriana wanted him to do would not only put his life in danger, it would also threaten his wives and even her...
Nux just wanted to somehow deal with this enemy before helping her...

He was only thinking of a way that was safest for everyone... that too, during the time when he should already be boiling in anger, frustration, and at the same time, feeling a sense of helplessness...
Lyriana could tell what Nux must have been feeling all this time... for more than 100 years...
And to think she would make selfish demands during this time...
Lyriana clenched her fists. Recalling Nux's eyes when he looked at her that day, Eyes that she felt were expressing his anger...

Now that she looked back and recalled those eyes again... she was able to see the helplessness veiled behind his anger and the moment she saw that, Lyriana felt like her entire world crumbled. Hate...
She was hating herself for what she did...
To lash out at the only person who saw her as more than a washed-up, crazy old woman, the only one who reached out with a helping hand when no one else would...
Not to mention she did so when he was probably at the lowest point of his life when the people he loved the most were under a threat and he was unable to help them...

The more she thought about all this, the more she blamed herself. "Stop thinking about it, you didn't know the whole situation, it is not your fault." Eisheth, who could tell what the woman was thinking about reassured her. "...that doesn't excuse what I did. I had no right to lash out at him like that, even if I didn't know anything, I was still in the wrong. I made an absurd request and didn't have enough patience to wait for him... my actions scream that I didn't trust him from the beginning...

I didn't trust the only person trying to help me..." Lyriana couldn't even lift her face anymore. "You were just desperate. It is normal to momentarily lose yourself in desperation." "You didn't," Lyriana spoke up. "You were in the same situation as me, you know there is a level beyond, a level you cannot reach, you must have been desperate as well, but you didn't act like me." "I was never desperate." Eisheth however, shook her head. "W-Wha-" Lyriana couldn't understand. "There is a world beyond the world, a mountain beyond the mountain. Who knows what's beyond what we know? I was never the strongest anyway, I simply accepted that fact." A small smile then appeared on Eisheth's face and, "I am a coward, Lyriana. Unlike the brave you, who is prepared to go against your fate, who has been trying to go against her fate, I gave in a lot earlier, So the reason you are in this position is because you are better than me.
There is no reason for you to feel low. In a journey where no one trusted you, you finally found someone who does. You lashed out at him because you considered him someone close to you.

It's easy for you to let your guard down around him, to show him your raw emotions, even the ones you try to hide from the rest of the world. You felt comfortable enough to let out your anger, frustration, and pain that you have been holding onto for thousands of years, in front of him because you trust him. That's what we do with people who mean something to us; we reveal our truest selves, For better... or worse." "Someone... close to me...?" Lyriana muttered those words out loud with a confused look on her face. Eisheth, who saw her face, smiled inwardly. 'Heh. I wonder what reward I can ask in return for this.'

Indeed, the Succubus Queen was no different from her daughter. Just like how Aisha slowly 'corrupted' her mother, the mother was now doing the same thing with another woman. Sure, Eisheth had her own reason for choosing Lyriana, the two of them were kind of in the same position, she felt a sense of comradery with her, but in the end, she was still doing all this for the 'rewards', that couldn't be denied. Right now, however, Eisheth knew that there was still a lot of work left, the woman was too passive, her head was too straightforward, intense and diligent to understand hints. "Yes. You lashed out at him because you feel safe around him. Sure, things got out of hand because of his situation, but what is more important is that you realized what you did. You can still make things right." "I can...?" Lyriana replied as she slowly turned her head towards the Succubus Queen. "Of course you can. Actually, you can do more than just make things right." Suddenly, a scheming smile appeared on Eisheth's face and, "In the end, whatever happened ultimately happened because Nux reacted much differently than he normally would, sure, he had his reasons, but you didn't know about that. It wasn't your mistake either yet he still lashed out at you, If you go to him, you can not only make things right again, You can even ask for more."

"More...?" Lyriana tilted her head. "Indeed." Eisheth nodded. Soon, however, she shrugged, "Well, not now, He is currently with Riona, then it is our turn, so it would still take him a few decades before he leaves our clutches." Eisheth spoke as he licked her lips. No matter how much she wanted to help this woman, there was no way she was going to give up on her turn. After all, she still needed to take her revenge. Thinking about it, Eisheth's purple shined with intense, unhidden lust, her face heating up in an instant, And Lyriana, who saw her condition, only continued to stare at the woman in silence, No one knew what the Elven Queen was thinking.

"It would take some time before I am able to he—"
"Nux, it is alright, I was impatient, I didn't know what you were going through, you ca—"
"No."
Nux interrupted.
"Let me complete."
He spoke, looking at Lyriana intensely.
The Elven Queen gave in and nodded lightly.
"It would take some time before I am able to help you.
Years, decades, or even centuries, I do not know how long it would take, but...
I give you my word that I will help you, and until I do, I want you by my side."
The Elven Queen stared at Nux and then, a light smile appeared on her face.
"I left my Kingdom and my Daughter for this, Nux.
You won't get rid of me that easily."
"Trust me, the last thing I want right now is to get rid of you."
Nux smiled as well.
The two stared at each other and then,
"Once again, I apologize."
"I apologize as well."
"You did nothing wro-"
"I did.
And I promise I will make up for it."
Seeing the look on her face, Nux knew there was no point in trying to convince her.
The Elven Queen was a prideful woman.
Her pride was no less than Vyriana's, and since she had made up her mind, nothing could be done.
"Then I will make you make up for it," Nux spoke.
Lyriana nodded.
"I will take my leave then."
"You should.
You have a new world you need to dominate just like you dominated Yrniel."
Lyriana smiled.
Nux smiled as well, then, suddenly, he moved forward, cupped Lyriana's cheek, touched her lips with his thumb, and before she could react, he disappeared.
"Take care of Eisheth, she is tired."
Lyriana, however, couldn't say anything.
She was too busy trying to understand what suddenly happened and... why her heart was beating so quickly.
Inside the Fortune's Call building, a woman with pale skin, three eyes, and dark purple hair was sitting on the counter, spending her day just like she normally would.
Her name was Arshia; her job was to help the mercenaries here whenever they came to her.
However, she wasn't exactly a hard worker.
Sure, she was good at her job, and that was the reason she wasn't kicked out despite trying to waste time with every opportunity she got.
She would chat with the mercenaries when she was bored, take a break when she was tired, and would just leave if she felt like it.
Even now, since no one was coming to her counter, she wanted to move to one of her colleague's counters and annoy her while she was working to pass time.
However, the moment she decided to move,
The doors of the building opened up, and a couple walked in.
A handsome man with long black hair and golden eyes and an equally beautiful woman with black hair and eyes.
The moment the couple entered, they attracted attention.
It was pretty normal; new faces normally attracted attention, especially when they were strong Sovereigns and that good-looking.
Of course, Arshia didn't care.
Sure, they were beautiful, but that's it.
Or...
At least, that's how things normally should be.
But then, the man suddenly glanced at her and started walking towards her with a smile on his face.
The woman beside him followed him.
Arshia paused.
Since they were coming to her, she couldn't just move, right?
Arshia smiled as she glanced at Nux and,
"A new face, finally."
She greeted.
The man reached her counter, and his smile widened,
"You look happy," he spoke.
"Of course.
Just look around, how often do you think I get to see an above-average face?"
Arshia chuckled.
The rest of the mercenaries present in the Hall stared at her with disapproving looks on their faces.
Clearly, they didn't like what she said, not that Arshia cared.
The man looked around; there were all sorts of people with different features here.
Most of them had rough looks, scars on their bodies, and were like bulky giants.
Seeing such a sight, the man looked back at Arshia and,
"I pity you."
"Right?!" Arshia slammed her desk in excitement, attracting even more attention from the mercenaries around.
"This is why I need a handsome man around me."
The woman quickly controlled herself, leaned her body forward, showing her cleavage as she stared at the man with a seductive look on her face.
Seeing her act like that, the man's smile widened.
He then leaned forward, excited, Arshia leaned forward as well.
The man then brought his mouth close to her ear, impressed by his boldness, she tilted her head, making it easier for the man to approach her, then suddenly, the man whispered,
"You shouldn't say those words."
"Huh?
What do you mean?" Arshia frowned.
Then the man pointed at the woman standing behind him and,
"She may be smiling, but she isn't any different from her daughter when it comes to such things."

chapters.title: Chapter 1709 I was standing behind you in the line.
paragraphs: "She may be smiling, but she isn't any different from her daughter when it comes to such things."
"H-Huh?"
Obviously, Arshia didn't understand what the man said.
"I am saying that she is a dangerous woman. If you hit on her husband, she will find you and kill you."
"W-When did I flirt with you?"
"Exactly." Nux nodded as he leaned away.
"Huh?"
Arshia was still confused.
Then suddenly, Riona stepped forward, holding Nux's arm in a way that it rested on her cleavage, making sure to claim her husband before any vixen eyed her.
"You seem quite desperate," Riona spoke as she glanced at Arshia.
Then, she looked around and sighed with a sympathetic look on her face.
"I guess I cannot blame you. Living in this environment must be difficult."
Riona's face then turned cold and, "But don't shoot your shot on him. He belongs to me."
"Yeah yeah, no one wants your man, woman." Arshia waved her hand.
"Now that hurts."
Nux pouted.
Arshia, who glanced at him, quickly shook her head, "I-I didn't mean it that wa-"
"It is okay. I was just teasing you." Nux chuckled.
Arshia didn't know how to react; for some reason, her face had turned red.
The rest of the people who saw her like that were surprised to see Arshia act that way. Nux, however, simply leaned forward again and, "Jokes aside, I actually needed your help."
"W-What can I do for you?"
"Special Missions. A friend told me to come to you if I wanted to do them."
"Ah, Special Missions. You came to the right person indeed." Arshia nodded.

"Actually, you need to do a few normal missions before you are eligible to do the Special Missions. You also need someone from Fortune's Call to vouch for you, but you don't have to worry about that. I'll do that for you. For now, you just need to complete a few missions. If you are in a hurry, then I can help you find some easier missions. You can complete them and be eligible for Special Missions. What do you say?"
"You would do that?"
"Of course, that is my job."
"You are quite hardworking. I knew I came to the right person." Nux smiled.
"Hahaha~ You can come to me anytime you need help. Oh, you still didn't tell me your name."
"I am Nux Leander."
"Nux Leander, huh..." Arshia repeated the name. It was as if she was burning it into her memory.
"And I am Riona 'Leander.' The same last name as his. In our world, the wives take their husband's last name."
"O-Oh." Arshia nodded.
'Arshia Leander... That doesn't sound too bad...' she thought as she glanced at Nux.
Yes, she completely ignored the woman standing next to him, something Riona didn't like one bit.
"Nux." She called out.
Nux turned towards her.
"You said there is a place where you can challenge anyone to a duel, no?" Riona was glaring at Arshia when she said those words, and Arshia, who realized it, felt her body tremble.
"A-Anyways, I am Arshia Markem. I will find a few missions for you; please give me a few minutes."
Sensing that her life was in danger, the woman quickly changed the topic. Then, she pointed in a certain direction and, "Please sit there, I will come to you."
"Thank you so much. You were a big help."
"Of course!"
Arshia nodded as she quickly stood up, wanting to leave. However, before she could, a man standing behind Nux and Riona called her, "Arshia."
He was in the queue.
"I am working. It might take 30 minutes, so please wait."
"Wai-"
Arshia, however, just said those words as she walked away, not listening to the man.

Nux just smiled as he and Riona then walked out of the counter, heading toward the seats Arshia had pointed at. As they were walking, Riona, who was holding Nux's arm with both her hands, suddenly pinched him with all her strength.
"Ouch!"
Nux groaned in pain as he glanced at his wife.
"Why were you flirting with her?" Riona questioned as she narrowed her eyes.
"What flirting? I was only being nice like you all told me to."
"That was just being nice...?" Riona raised her eyebrow.
"Of course. Did you see me flirt at all?"
"Did you not see her reaction? She was falling all over you! It was as if you were using your Incubus Powers!"
"You think she would react that calmly if I had used it?"
Riona turned silent.
"Anyways, we got what we wanted, didn't we?"
"I still don't like how you flirted with her."
"I just talked, woman."

Riona had no words. She was actually reconsidering their decision. She had forgotten how frustrating the playful Nux was; he was charming women left and right! How could he not see that three-eyed woman falling all over him? She even left her counter to help him; what sort of employee does that!?
'Tsk, but I guess it does get the work done.'
In the end, Riona calmed herself down. Also, seeing Nux smile like this was something that made her happy, so even if he attracted a few women in the process, it was okay.
'As long as I get rid of them.'
Yes, Riona was having dangerous thoughts.
"Oi."
While the couple was bantering with each other, someone called.
"Hm?"
Nux and Riona turned around.
"Do we know you?" Nux questioned. He couldn't recognize the man.
"I was standing behind you in the line."
"Uhh... and?"
Nux tilted his head.
Did he want a pat on his back for following the rules or something?
"Now I need to wait 30 minutes before I can get the mission I want."
Did he want a pat on his back for following the rules or something?
"Now I need to wait 30 minutes before I can get the mission I want."
The man spoke, and Nux's frown deepened.
Why the hell was this man telling him his sob story? Did he mistakenly give out the impression that he cared?
Then suddenly, the man smiled, "Now that I have to wait because of you, don't you think you should compensate somehow?" The man spoke as he glanced at Riona.

chapters.title: Chapter 1710 What a barbaric man.
paragraphs: "Now that I have to wait because of you,
don't you think you should compensate somehow?"
The man spoke as he glanced at Riona, and in an instant, Nux's expression changed.
However, before he could act out, Riona suddenly smiled,
"Well, well, don't you look like a strong one."
Hearing her words, the man's smile widened,
"I see you have a good eye. How did you end up with a man like him in the first place?"
"Hmmm."
Riona started thinking.
"He killed the father of my daughter, then he seduced my daughter, and then finally he extended his clutches towards me."
The woman replied, and as she finished, everyone in the hall was staring at them.
Even the man standing in front of them was taken aback.
He came in here as a bad guy, but hearing what Nux did, he wasn't sure who was worse.
Of course, the man also realized that it was his chance to get his hands on this beautiful woman; therefore,
"What a barbaric man."
"Indeed.
He is quite barbaric."
Riona nodded as she glanced at Nux with a playful look on her face.
Nux's mouth twitched continuously.
"You don't have to be scared. He cannot do anything to you here; I will protect you."
The man spoke.
"You will?" Riona questioned, her eyes filled with hope.
"Of course! My blood boils when I see such a barbaric man having his way with you."
Then suddenly, the man threw a piece of cloth at Nux, which he obviously avoided since it looked like it was drenched in sweat.
"You!
I challenge you to a duel in the Arena!
If you lose, you are to leave her in an instant!"
The man declared loudly, gathering the attention of everyone around.
Even the ones who were completely uninterested in the conversation a while ago.
After all, who would miss a free action-packed drama?
"Too bothersome." Nux, however, was a buzzkill.
"Are you scar-"
Before the man could provoke him into fighting,
"Arena requires you to register, give details of both warriors, set a date, and all that."
Nux then glanced at the man and,
"Why go so far when we can skip all the formalities and settle it outside?"
"Huh...?" the man frowned.
"He wants you to follow him and fight it out outside."
Riona explained with a light, playful smile.
"..." The man narrowed his eyes.
He looked around before his eyes fell on 3 people sitting at a certain table.
The man momentarily paused; Nux guessed that he was communicating with someone using some method.
"Let's go."
Suddenly, the man spoke up.
"Wow, you are so brave~
I knew you were a great warrior the moment I saw you."
Riona praised, both her hands clenched together.
Nux, on the other hand, just walked out, and the man followed. As the two of them left, three more men walked out.
Riona, who saw them, couldn't help but shake her head.
How could she not see what they were trying to do?
Not that it mattered; all of them were Divines.
Honestly, with Nux's current level, you could bring thousands of Divines in front of him, and it wouldn't take more than a few seconds.
Of course, unlike her, others weren't too sure.
"You! What are you doing!?"
Arshia, who had rushed towards her the instant those 3 men left, shouted.
"You were just talking about how he was yours and whatnot! If you wanted to leave him, then you should have! Why are you making a scene!?"
Riona didn't know how to react.
"What are you silent for?
Do you even know who that man was!? And those 3 who left after them, all of them know each other! They are going to attack Nux together!
I swear to god, if something happens to him, I won't let you have an easy life!"
"You seem quite worried about him."
Riona chuckled.
"Of course I am! He is..."
"He is...?"
"He is my customer!"
"Ah right." Riona nodded.
"Then why don't you go and help him?"
"W-What...?"
Arshia stuttered.
"If you are so worried about your customer to go as far as threatening your other customer, shouldn't you go and help him before something happens to him?"
"How am I supposed to help him...?"
Riona chuckled at the response.
It was funny how someone who couldn't even step up was threatening a woman who spent more than 100 years unconscious because she protected the man they were talking about.
"You!"
Seeing Riona laugh, Arshia was enraged.
"It must have been your plan from the beginning!" she shouted.
"Yes, yes, now don't bother me. You still have work to do. Go find the missions."
"You think I would do that for yo-"
"Arshia? Did you already bring the missions? That was much faster than I expected."
Suddenly, Arshia heard a voice; she turned around and noticed Nux walking in with a smile on his face.
"N-Nux! You are okay!"
Arshia spoke as she rushed towards him.
However, before she could get to him and hug him, she suddenly saw Riona standing next to him, once again, with her arms wrapped around his arm.
"H-Huh?"
Arshia stuttered.
She looked back to where the woman was standing.
"H-How did you..."
However, before she could continue,
"Hmm? Why do you look so surprised?" Nux tilted his head in confusion.
"She thought that those fou-"
"Nothing! Nothing!
I just came here to tell you to wait a little longer, I will finish it as soon as I can! Please be patient!"
Arshia interrupted Riona.
"Sure, we will wait." Nux smiled.
Arshia then walked away, and once she did, Riona laughed out loud.
"You sure are enjoying yourself."
"Now I get why you like to play around so much." Riona chuckled.
"Don't pin this on me. You started it.
I still can't forget how awfully you were acting; to think he fell for something like that.
Not to mention you ruined my image before I could even build it.
I couldn't believe they called me a sex fiend when the four of them surrounded me because they were eyeing my wife."

"Hmm? You know him?" Riona frowned as she glanced at the one-eyed man standing in front of her. "I don't."
Nux shook his head.
"It seems like he knows you!"
"I did sense someone looking at me when I was out-oh, wait!
Suddenly, Nux recalled who the man was.
Ile was Vajra, the one-eyed demon with special eyes who was watching Nux when he was dealing with Skeleton and his little gang.
Previously, Nux had noticed him looking at him from afar; even now, Nux knew that someone was keeping an eye on him. However, this time, he didn't bother checking who it was.
'So it was him.
A smile appeared on Nux's face.
"You really like to watch business you aren't involved in, don't you?"
Vajra's body trembled.
Once again, the fear that had subsided after all this time came out again.

More than five decades had passed since Nux was last seen in this place. Vajra just thought that he had left or was done in by someone stronger. He didn't even recognize him before because it had been so long and his attitude was so different.
However, seeing the man deal with those four men even more cruelly than he did with others, those buried memories came out.
Once again, he was worried about his life. He was spared before, but now that he had repeated the same mistake, he thought he would die. However,
"Well, I guess resisting the urge to watch free entertainment isn't exactly an easy thing to do. So I don't blame you!
Suddenly, Nux shrugged.
"I do wish to know, though, how do you even keep an eye on me? I was pretty far back then. Does your eye have the power to see through walls?"
He questioned with a curious look on his face.
For cultivators, normal walls didn't mean anything, but that only applied to a limited range. In Vajra's case, however, this range seemed to be much longer than anyone else's.
Vajra was silent.
As much as he wanted to flaunt his powers, he was currently standing in front of a being who noticed him trying to watch and looked back at him.
How was he supposed to flex his senses in front of someone who was far superior to him in that regard?
"Hmm? Don't wish to answer?"
"Nux, why would anyone tell you about their power?" Riona questioned.
Then, she held her husband's arm and pulled him away. As the two sat on the chair, Riona placed her head on Nux's shoulder and closed her eyes.
Instantly, Nux's attention was diverted. He placed his hand over Riona's waist and pulled her close to him.
His Riona was finally with him.
That was all that mattered. Some one-eyed dude didn't.
Vajra, who was completely ignored, didn't mind this one bit. He slowly walked out of the building. making sure not to attract the monster's attention, and once he was out, he ran away.
Time passed. Twenty minutes later, Arshia came to Nux with a few papers.
"Nux! I found these for you. In total, you need to do ten missions to be eligible for Special Missions.
I have chosen these twenty missions that should be easy to do for you. You can choose any ten of
them!"
The woman quickly passed the papers to Nux with a bright smile on her face.
"I am really thankful, Arshia.
"Of course! As I said, I am only doing my job."
"You are very good at it." Nux smiled.
Arshia's smile widened, "You should quickly select the missions, or do you need some days?"
"No, I'll choose the first ten."
Nux spoke as he returned the papers to Arshia.
"What...? You didn't even read anything, though..."
"Why would I?
I trust you, Arshia.
The instant he said those words, Arshia's face turned red.
"A-Alright, then I will register them in your name. You can come to me as soon as you are done with
the missions."
She spoke as she quickly moved, stamping different papers left and right, writing something on a register, and handling some other formalities.
Riona, who saw her move, couldn't help but smile,
"So? What are these missions?"
"Nothing much. I need to go to some Lowest and Low Levels Worlds. Most of them require me to retrieve some artifacts. In some, I need to collect some beasts' horns and stuff. They seem easy
enough."
Obviously, Nux didn't trust the woman one bit. He read through all the missions; it's just that he did it so quickly that Arshia couldn't perceive it.
Nux's brain was currently on an entirely different level. Let alone Arshia, even Riona wasn't able to
read anything by the time Nux was done with everything. He didn't even need to look at the page; he could process everything from the bundle using his senses.
Yes, it meant that. Nux was capable of reading an entire book with a single look. He didn't even have
to flip the pages.
"You are so mean, Nux.
You lie as easily as breathing!
Riona chuckled, pitying the poor woman who had just fallen in love.
"People get over their crushes soon enough, don't worry!
Nux shrugged.
As they talked, Arshia suddenly came to them and,
"Here, these are the missions you selected. Please do them as soon as possible!"
"I will be back soon.
Nux smiled as he grabbed the papers.
"I will be waiting!" Arshia nodded, and Nux smiled again.

chapters.title: Chapter 1712 Y-You completed the missions?
paragraphs: "Nux!"
Once again, Nux and Riona walked into the Fortune's Call building, Arshia, who saw them, instantly brightened up as she rushed towards them.
Yes, just like before, she wasn't doing anything and was free.
"You are back!"
Arshia spoke.
Nux smiled, then passed the mission papers Arshia had given him, making her frown.
"What happened? Did you not like these missions? I can change them if you want."
"What do you mean? I completed them!
"What...?"
Arshia blinked a few times, unable to register the words she just heard.
"I said I completed them. Where do I submit the items I secured?"
Nux questioned.
"Y-You completed the missions?"
Nux nodded.
"But I only gave them to you yesterday..."
"Uhh... I am fast...?"
"Fast...?"
Arshia didn't know how to react.
If it were anyone other than Nux, she would have lashed out already.
Fast!? What the hell did he mean by fast!?

There were 10 missions, some of them requiring infiltrating and sneaking into a heavily guarded base. One of the missions required him to kill 100 beasts that were particularly difficult to kill because of their hard bodies.
Sure, she selected the comparatively casier ones for him, but these were still missions only a Sovereign could do, and each would take at least a month.
Just going to some worlds mentioned in the missions would take more than a few days unless one had an excellently made mode of transport.
Which, Nux did.

The Cosmocraft Aellana gave him wasn't an ordinary one. It looked plain, but it was personally made by the Dwarven Progenitors. They had the power to increase their speed proportional to the energy infused in them without having to worry about overloading.
And when it came to energy....
Nux was sure there was no Divine in the entire universe with more energy than him.

Nux wasn't just a Divine; he was a Divine who had constantly devoured his own cultivation using the Black Hole and reached a point of saturation where doing so any further didn't make any difference. If he was the one infusing energy, there weren't many spaceships faster than the Cosmocraft given to him.
Of course, this still didn't mean that he could complete all these missions on his own.

Actually, Nux didn't even get the chance to complete any of the missions on his own. The moment he returned with the mission papers, Riona called the rest of the women, and quickly, those papers were taken away, and the missions were divided.
Infiltrating? They had Riona, Rune, and Thyra; even Shadow Lane participated in the mission.
Killing beasts? Astaria and Vyriana were the first to get their hands on the missions.
Felberta, Amaya, Evane, Edda, Allura, Aisha, Ember, Melia, and Skyla didn't stay behind either, all of them eager to complete the missions they selected.
Just like that,
One had to know, an 'average' Sovereign was supposed to find these missions easy, and... none of Nux's women were 'average.'

Even if some of them didn't have an Absolute Law, the Laws they had formed were ridiculously powerful. Not to mention, the women connected with Nux had all had their bloodlines raised to the Primordial level of a Middle-Level World's bloodline.
With strong Laws, strong bloodlines, and constant training under a maniac like Vyriana, these women were far from normal.
Even in the Outer Space they hadn't explored yet, only Sovereigns from high-level worlds could be their match, and that was just the women who had normal Laws.

As for Vyriana, Astaria, and Amaya, the ones with Absolutes... they were even stronger than Sovereigns from a high-level world. After all, Absolutes were rare, extremely rare. Only the best in the universe have the ability to form Absolutes.
Therefore, within a single day...
All 10 missions were completed without Nux having to lift a single finger.
The only thing they needed to be mindful of was that all the women connected to Nux couldn't enter any world alone.
Just like how the Universe couldn't sense Nux, it couldn't sense the women connected to him either. And if the Universe couldn't... how would a normal world be able to do it?
Just like the Universe, the worlds couldn't sense Nux and his women, nor could they sense their arrival.

Normally, every time a being from another world enters a world, it senses their presence and informs the being closest to it, usually the World's Child, along with the location of the otherworlder who had infiltrated.

However, this wouldn't happen if Nux and his women were the ones doing the infiltration. So if they entered a world and the world didn't inform the World Child about them, it would raise suspicion. Even when Nux entered Nexus alone, Nexus shouldn't have been able to sense him, so the strongest. beings in Nexus wouldn't know about him. It was something that would definitely raise doubts, but since Nexus was a mercenary world where countless beings come in every single day, it didn't matter as much.

However, the same couldn't be done with normal worlds. Therefore, every time women who couldn't be sensed by the world came in, they came together with the women who could be sensed and stayed hidden until there were no eyes around, so it wouldn't raise any doubts.

Of course, since they only visited lowest- or low-level worlds for these missions, it didn't pose many problems. The missions were completed without any issues, and right now, Nux stood in front of the shocked Arshia, ready to submit everything his women brought back from the missions.
"Y-You really c-completed them..."
Arshia stuttered as she saw a bunch of items placed on her counters.
It wasn't just her; everyone in the hall was looking at the counter as well.
While there were people who liked to do a few missions at the same time and would return with lots
of items, the people in the hall heard the conversation between Nux and Arshia.
They knew Nux got all this in one day...
"I-Is that even possible?"
"...It shouldn't be."
Conversations started, but Nux ignored it all and,
"Does this mean I can get a Special Mission now?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1713 A Nexus Identity Card.
paragraphs: "Does this mean I can get a Special Mission now?" Nux questioned, and Arshia, who came out of her reverie, nodded quickly.
"O-Of course!"

She had no clue how this man did it; however, since the items were placed right in front of her eyes, it meant the missions were completed. It didn't matter if Nux was the one who completed the mission or if he got someone else to do it; since he was the one who registered it, according to the rules, he would be the one to get rewarded.
Nexus was never the place that cared about the 'how' in the first place.
As long as you returned with the desired result, you would get what you wanted.
Without wasting any time, Arshia extended her hands over the items Nux brought. A blue light came out of her palm; it was as if this light was scanning the items.
And as if scanning was not enough, Nux saw certain items disappearing from his sight.

Within a moment, he realized that the items that disappeared all came from completing a single mission, and once she was done collecting the items of this particular mission, she started collecting other items from another mission.
Yes, Arshia was sorting out the items Nux brought without any equipment, and she was doing it. extremely efficiently.
'Is this related to her power? Nux wondered.

Only after looking at the woman did he realize that, despite having seen the memories of a few mercenaries who stayed in Nexus and had known Arshia for thousands of years, none of them knew what the woman's abilities were.
Not just that, they had never seen anyone with features similar to Arshia either.

It was as if Arshia was the only one of her race present in Nexus, which was quite surprising since Nexus was one of the biggest mercenary worlds. The number of people from all kinds of races here was so high that one would always find more than a few people of the same race here.
Nux even saw a few more humans other than him and Riona here.
Not just humans; there were other races of Yrniel present here as well.
"Heh? Why are you looking at me like that? Your eyes seem like you want to say something"
Suddenly, Arshia, who saw Nux looking at her, smiled playfully, her three eyes all looking at Nux in a flirty manner.
However, before Nux could answer,
"Yes, he does want to say something" Riona jumped in. The woman stared at the bitch in front of her and,

"He wants to ask how long you're going to keep us waiting. Can't you do it quickly? You've been working here for a long time, no? Then why are you so slow? Are you sure you're as competent as you try to show?"
Arshia's mouth twitched.
She had no clue what was wrong with this woman.
Of course, she completely ignored the fact that she was the one trying to flirt with the woman's husband.
In the end, Arshia ignored Riona. A minute later, all the items disappeared, and Arshia nodded. "Yes, the missions are marked as completed:"
The woman then suddenly took out a card and passed it to Nux.
Nux blinked in surprise.
He knew what it was.
A Nexus Identity Card.
It was something all mercenaries had; it was similar to an ID card, however, it was much more practical. Along with the ID card, it was also similar to a bank account.

The card uses Space Magic, which allows it to store Nexus Credits inside. The credits can be transferred directly into one's account, and if one wanted, they could access the space and take out the credits in physical form whenever they wished.
It was quite a convenient thing to have.
What surprised Nux, however, was the fact that the Nexus card this woman was passing to him belonged to... him?
From what he knew, he needed to go to the Nexus Hall and register in order to create a Nexus card for himself.
However, since the process took around two weeks, Nux decided to skip it and was ready to take physical payment.
After all, payments didn't matter to him; he could always kill the ones seeking death and get the money.
It was not like he was planning on staying here for a long time anyway.
However,
"I noticed you didn't have it, so I registered it for you.
This is yours!

Seeing his surprise, Arshia smiled. She then secretly glanced at Riona with a smug look on her face. Riona, however, nonchalantly grabbed Nux's arm and pulled him close to her. Then, she glanced at Arshia and smirked.
It was as if she was saying,
"The one you're trying so hard for is already mine!
Arshia's body trembled in anger.
If only she could kill this woman right now.
Of course, the three-eyed woman had no idea how dangerous that thought was.
After all, all this while, she had only seen Nux's "normal" side.
If only she had seen what happened to those four men who followed Nux out and what state they
ended up in, never in her life would she ever think that way.
"I heard it takes two weeks to get it," Nux questioned.
"Well, that's for normal people.
You are special.'
"Special?"
Nux frowned.
Did he somehow gain someone's attention?
But he didn't sense any eyes looking at him, though...
"How many times do you think I personally go to Nexus Hall to register someone?"
Arshia declared with a proud look on her face.
"They had to skip a few formalities since I said I wouldn't leave until they gave me the card.
I got it in three hours."
Arshia smiled, staring at Nux with eyes full of expectations.
"Thank you!"
Nux smiled as he took the card.
Arshia's smile widened.
"Don't worry, it's my job-"
The rest of the employees and even the mercenaries who heard those words all stared at the
shameless woman, thinking about just one thing:
'You do anything but your job.
