Why are you looking at me like that?
Your eyes seem like you want to say something"
Suddenly, Arshia, who saw Nux looking at her, smiled playfully, her three eyes all looking at Nux in a flirty manner.
However, before Nux could answer,
"Yes, he does want to say something" Riona jumped in.
The woman stared at the bitch in front of her and,
"He wants to ask how long you're going to keep us waiting.
Can't you do it quickly?
You've been working here for a long time, no?
Then why are you so slow?
Are you sure you're as competent as you try to show?"
Arshia's mouth twitched.
She had no clue what was wrong with this woman.
Of course, she completely ignored the fact that she was the one trying to flirt with the woman's husband.
In the end, Arshia ignored Riona.
A minute later, all the items disappeared, and Arshia nodded.
"Yes, the missions are marked as completed:"
The woman then suddenly took out a card and passed it to Nux.
Nux blinked in surprise.
He knew what it was.
A Nexus Identity Card.
It was something all mercenaries had; it was similar to an ID card, however, it was much more practical.
Along with the ID card, it was also similar to a bank account.
The card uses Space Magic, which allows it to store Nexus Credits inside.
The credits can be transferred directly into one's account, and if one wanted, they could access the space and take out the credits in physical form whenever they wished.
It was quite a convenient thing to have.
What surprised Nux, however, was the fact that the Nexus card this woman was passing to him belonged to... him?
From what he knew, he needed to go to the Nexus Hall and register in order to create a Nexus card for himself.
However, since the process took around two weeks, Nux decided to skip it and was ready to take physical payment.
After all, payments didn't matter to him; he could always kill the ones seeking death and get the money.
It was not like he was planning on staying here for a long time anyway.
However,
"I noticed you didn't have it, so I registered it for you.
This is yours!
Seeing his surprise, Arshia smiled.
She then secretly glanced at Riona with a smug look on her face.
Riona, however, nonchalantly grabbed Nux's arm and pulled him close to her.
Then, she glanced at Arshia and smirked.
It was as if she was saying,
"The one you're trying so hard for is already mine!
Arshia's body trembled in anger.
If only she could kill this woman right now.
Of course, the three-eyed woman had no idea how dangerous that thought was.
After all, all this while, she had only seen Nux's "normal" side.
If only she had seen what happened to those four men who followed Nux out and what state they
ended up in, never in her life would she ever think that way.
"I heard it takes two weeks to get it," Nux questioned.
"Well, that's for normal people.
You are special.'
"Special?"
Nux frowned.
Did he somehow gain someone's attention?
But he didn't sense any eyes looking at him, though...
"How many times do you think I personally go to Nexus Hall to register someone?"
Arshia declared with a proud look on her face.
"They had to skip a few formalities since I said I wouldn't leave until they gave me the card.
I got it in three hours."
Arshia smiled, staring at Nux with eyes full of expectations.
"Thank you!"
Nux smiled as he took the card.
Arshia's smile widened.
"Don't worry, it's my job-"
The rest of the employees and even the mercenaries who heard those words all stared at the
shameless woman, thinking about just one thing:
'You do anything but your job.

chapters.title: Chapter 1714 Special Missions
paragraphs: 'You do anything but your job.
The mercenaries and other employees present in the Hall thought at the same time as they stared at Arshia smiling like a fool as she glanced at Nux.
"Tsk, what does she even see in him?"
One of the mercenaries snorted.
"Stay silent, will you?" Another mercenary sitting next to him replied.
"Huh? What do you mean?" the first mercenary frowned.
"Did you not realize it yet?"
"Realize what?"
"You hardheaded fool..." the second mercenary facepalmed.
"Are you looking for a fight?"
"Those four men still hadn't returned: Instead of fighting, the mercenary decided to explain. "So?"

"He went out alone, four people followed him, clearly, their intentions weren't good. However, the one who returned was him, and that too, without any injuries. Let alone injuries, he doesn't even look like he fought.
Not just that, did you forget how the one-eyed bastard reacted when he saw him return? I wouldn't be shocked if he had pissed in fear.
Those one-eyed bastards see what others aren't able to, he must have seen something for him to shake in terror like that,
Something... we shouldn't try and touch..."
The mercenary spoke with a grave look on his face.

It was just him, most mercenaries here could already tell that Nux wasn't normal. They were all battle-hardened beings who spent their entire lives on different battlefields. Obviously, their senses were far stronger than normal.
Therefore, no one wanted to get into a fight for no reason.
"So, can I get the Special Missions now?"
Nux questioned.
"Of course you can'
Arshia smiled brightly as she then picked a few papers and passed them to Nux.

"These are all the Special Missions available, you can choose any of them. However, unlike normal missions, I cannot allow you to pick more than one Special Mission, so select carefully, okay?" Arshia spoke. Nux, however, didn't reply, and a frown appeared on his face as he held the papers. Suddenly, he started reading the contents written on the paper, something he didn't need to do since he had already read all of that. He just wanted to make sure his ability was working fine.
However, the more he read, the deeper his frown got.
"These are... just normal missions?"
He spoke as he glanced at Arshia.
They were the same.
Collect Monster parts, infiltrate, gather information, and other basic stuff, all of these were no different than the normal missions he completed before.
"Hmm? What do you mean?"
Arshia tilted her head.
"Did you not see at the bottom? Look at the rewards. A normal mission of this level would only give you 300 Nexus Credits, but this one offers 1000 Credits.
This one is the same, you would normally..."
Arshia started showing the difference in rewards.
"The Special Missions are just normal missions with higher rewards?"
"Well, not exactly.

Don't underestimate Special Missions; there is a reason the rewards are higher than normal. A normal mission becomes a special mission when the attempt to clear it fails three times or more. The death rates are also higher in Special Missions, and in most cases, the information provided in the mission description isn't accurate, so you might need to face a threat you are not prepared for. They are definitely not normal missions"
"Weren't Special Missions supposed to be something else? Enlisting in the ongoing war, for example?
Nux questioned.
From the memories he had read, missions related to war were called special missions.
Arshia, however, stared at Nux with a dumbfounded look on her face. Then, she chuckled, "Hahaha~ I sometimes forget you are a new mercenary because of how you act."
"What do you mean?"
"Well, those missions are only available for Star Mercenaries"

Nux narrowed his eyes. This was the first time he had heard of this term. None of the ones he killed knew about this, and soon, he learned the reason as Arshia suddenly waved her hand and a barrier rose around them.
"The missions you are talking about are the ones that are usually given by our VIP customers.
We can't possibly hand them over to normal mercenaries since our reputation is on the line here! "My friends didn't know of this!"
Nux replied.
"Well then, I am sorry to say, but your friend must not be a very excellent mercenary.
Why do you think I raised the barrier?"
Arshia questioned.

"It is to not let others hear what I am talking about? It is not like something would change even if they did know, we just avoid telling them that there are missions with better rewards than Special Missions since we cannot leave these missions to the incompetent ones.
The only reason I am telling you about this is because you seem like an exceptional mercenary. I
have never seen someone complete ten missions in a single day. Now, it doesn't matter how you did it, nor do I care about it.
What I do care about is that you seem resourceful, a trait found in a quality mercenary.
You can think of it as me choosing you, separating you from the rest of the crowd.'
Arshia smiled.
"Does that mean I can do those missions?"
Nux questioned.
Arshia, however, shook her head.

"That is not possible. I can make an exception with Special Missions since I have a bit of authority, but as I said, these missions are given by our VIP customers. Oftentimes, these are the leaders of Middle Level Worlds, or even from the High Level Worlds. We cannot afford to disappoint them, since it would be a big loss if they go to someone else with their business.
Arshia explained.
"But since you are telling me about all this..."
Nux spoke, and Arshia's smile widened,
"Yes, what you are thinking is correct.
I believe you have what it takes to become our Star Mercenary"
"How do I do that?"
"Well, that is easy enough. You just need your name to be known throughout Nexus. The fastest way
to do it is to complete more Special Missions!
"How many?"
"Hmm...
About a hundred?
Well, there are a lot of other factors, like how fast you completed it, the failure rate, and other stuff,
but you still need to complete at least a hundred Special Missions to become a Star Mercenary" "Alright, give me a hundred Special Missions, then!"

Well, there are a lot of other factors, like how fast you completed it, the failure rate, and other stuff, but you still need to complete at least 100 Special Missions to become a Star Mercenary."
"Alright, give me 100 Special Missions then!
Nux nodded, but Arshia just chuckled.
"You look so desperate.
If you show this persistence while chasing a woman, you could get anyone you want, you know? Of course, that face would help a lot as well!
Arshia chuckled.
"Right now, I am more focused on the missions. I can't just keep chasing women, now can I? It wouldn't do well for my image!"
"IImm, I guess that is true. I wouldn't want a man who constantly thinks about chasing after women." "See? Why would I do something that would make me unlikable in your eyes?'
Nux smiled as he leaned forward.
The moment he did that, Arshia froze, her face flushed as she found herself lost in Nux's eyes. Then suddenly,
*flick*
"Ackk!"
Nux flicked the woman's nose, making her flinch in pain.
"What are you thinking about, Arshia?
Shouldn't you do your job and give me the 100 Special Missions that I need to complete?"
"O-Of course!
Arshia came out of her reverie and nodded as she started picking more Special Missions. But then, as she realized what she was doing, she paused.
"What happened?"
"I can't do that."
"IImm?"

"As I said before, you can only take one Special Mission at a time. We do this to avoid Mercenaries hoarding all the Missions to themselves and not letting other mercenaries complete them." "Can't you make an exception? I promise I won't hoard the missions for long!
"Even I cannot go against this rule," Arshia shook her head again.
"Well, this makes it difficult, Nux commented.
Then, he looked at Arshia and questioned,
"Is there no faster way to become a Star Mercenary?"
"Actually, didn't she say we need to make our name known throughout Nexus? I am sure there will be faster ways of doing that than completing 100 Missions."
Riona spoke up, and Arshia glanced at the woman and laughed.
"And what are you going to do to achieve that? Complete a Black Mission that has been abandoned by all?
"Black Mission?" Nux didn't miss that.
"Ah, it's nothing you should worry about." Arshia waved her hands in a dismissive manner.
"No, I want to know about it. What is it?" Nux insisted.
"It is nothing.
As I said, they are abandoned Missions; they do not exist anymore."
"Why is that?"
Nux questioned.
Arshia stared at Nux and frowned, but seeing the look on his face-one that looked like he wasn't going to back down unless he knew what it was-Arshia just sighed.
"Sometimes, your persistence is annoying, you know?
You should be glad that you are attractive!
The woman then made sure the sound barrier was still working fine and then,
"How things work in most mercenary halls is that a customer puts in a Mission that is to be completed.
First, the Mission is listed in the normal section.

If the mercenaries fail to complete that mission three times, we reach our customer and tell them the results; we then ask if they want us to put the mission in the Special Section and tell them how the cost of the mission completion would be affected by it. If the customer agrees, their mission then becomes a Special Mission.

Of course, it is different for VIP customers; since they are VIPS, we make sure to complete the Mission on the first try, and even if we don't, we rarely go back to our client and continue to raise the reward of the said mission on our own, even if it affects our own pockets.
However, every once in a while, there comes a Mission that cannot be completed, no matter how much manpower is used.
Missions that we have no choice but to abandon, even if it comes from a VIP.
Of course, this affects our image, and the VIP usually leaves and gets some other Mercenary Hall to complete it. Usually, it is a Mercenary Hall that is on a higher level than ours.
Sometimes, they even go to Mercenary Halls that are not in Nexus and are in other Mercenary Worlds.
It is regrettable, but that is how things are; you cannot satisfy every customer, no matter how hard you try"
"So the Black Missions you talked about are the Missions that are abandoned since the customer went to some other Mercenary Hall and they completed the Mission instead of you guys?"
"No"
Arshia shook her head.
"Those are called Closed Missions"
"Then what are the Black Missions?"
"Black Missions are the ones that are not Closed."
"Not closed?"
"We close the Mission when the customer informs us that the Mission is completed or that there is no need to complete the Mission anymore.
"So the Black Missions..."
"Yes, the Black Missions are the Missions that are not yet completed, even after the customer has contacted other Mercenary Halls.
And since, in most cases, the customers who come with these cases are VIPs who do not care about money, the number of Mercenary Halls they have contacted is absurdly high.
This one, in particular, I wouldn't be surprised if they even contacted High-Level Mercenary
Worlds"
"But if the Mission is still not closed..."
"Yes, it means that let alone other Mercenary Halls in Nexus, even the Mercenary Halls in High-Level Mercenary Worlds have failed to complete this Mission.
It has been abandoned throughout the Universe, and no Mercenary Hall is willing to touch it. Every Mercenary Party that has taken this mission has never returned alive.
This is why it is called the Black Mission that has been abandoned by all."
Arshia explained, just thinking about the number of merc
ercenaries who died trying to complete the
mission made her sigh in disappointment. Soon, however, she shook her head and,
"Anyways, as I was saying, you need to do hund-"
"This Black Mission, would I become a Star Mercenary if I complete it?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1716 You, kid, I like you.
paragraphs: "This Black Mission, would I become a Star Mercenary if I complete it?"
Nux suddenly questioned, interrupting Arshia mid-sentence.
Arshia froze. For a moment, she thought Nux was joking, however, when she saw him staring at her with a serious look on his face, she realized he was not.
"Nux, forget about this. Blac-'
"Please tell me."
"I will not! You can't put your life in danger like that!
Black Missions, especially this one, are nothing but suicide!
Do you not understand!?
No mercenary, no matter how good their track record was, returned alive. Every single one of them was dead!
There is a reason why so many Mercenary Halls abandoned this Mission despite risking angering a VIP customer!
You cannot do i-'
"Judging by how you are reacting, it is possible, isn't it?"
"Wha-?"
"I can become a Star Mercenary if I complete this Mission, correct?"
"You can! You can become more than just a Star Mercenary, but it wouldn't do you any good if you end up dead before achieving that!

Why don't you let me find an easy Special Mission for you? Complete it, then complete ninety-nine mor- no, screw that, eighty! Complete eighty missions, and I will somehow make you a Star Mercenary. How does that sound?"
Seeing how desperately the woman was trying to convince him, Nux could tell that she wouldn't change her mind so easily. In the end, he had to change his approach.
"Let's do this."
He called out.

"Let me just see what the Mission is. If I think I cannot complete it, I will not do it. How about that?" "...Nux, there is a reason why so many people died in that mission. It is not something you can complete even if you have an entire army supporting you!"
"Please let me be the judge of that.
Trust me, I have no intention of dying.
There are people I cannot possibly leave behind!
Nux smiled.
Seeing his stubbornness, Arshia turned silent.
"Please help me, Arshia."
Nux spoke, and in the end, Arshia just lowered her head.
"I can't show you the mission.
Nux frowned.
"If you wish to see the Mission, you need to go to the Upper Floor. Only they have the authority over missions like that. I will put in a word for you, so be ready to meet them in an hour."
Arshia spoke, then looked at Nux with determined eyes and,
"And make sure to reject the mission once you realize that it cannot be completed!
Don't do something foolish because of a short-term benefit"
Hearing those words, Nux chuckled.
"I will not."
He assured.
"Then go sit over there, I will put in a request!"
"I knew I could rely on you"
Nux smiled, but this time, Arshia just snorted,
"Talk to me when you reject the mission!"
Nux chuckled again. Then he and Riona walked towards the seat Arshia pointed at.
"She is a strange one. I can't believe she is the same woman who sent me away the last time I met her. I wonder how she would react if she remembers that!
Nux turned towards Riona since he didn't hear a reply, and seeing the look on her face, he smiled wryly.
"Riona, we cannot kill her."
"Don't worry, no one will know it is us. I'll get Thyra to do it!
Riona spoke as she showed her palm.
There was a hair on it.
Nux frowned; soon, however, he connected the dots, and his eyes widened in surprise.
"Is tha-'
"Yeah, it's hers.
Considering her level, a hair should be more than enough!

chapters.title: Chapter 1717 The Reaper’s Veil.
paragraphs: "You, kid, I like you!"
Then he placed his finger on the table and,
"However, I still cannot let you take the Mission!"
Nux frowned,
"Why is that?"
"Because it is pointless!
"You are saying that even without letting me see the details of the mission?"
"Yes.
As I said, I like the way you think.
You will make it big in the Mercenary World, but for that, you need to survive, and going on this mission wouldn't make that happen!"
"Let me see the mission first, I'll be the one to decide."
Nux insisted.
The Lion Head stared at him for a while, then, he sighed.
Suddenly, a bundle of papers appeared in front of him.
Nux frowned; he wanted to see only one mission, not a bunch of them. However, the moment he read those papers, he realized this bundle was one single mission,
The Black Mission.
And the more details he read, the more solemn his expression became.
"The Reaper's Veil!
Suddenly, the Lion Head started.
He stared at. Nux and continued,
"That's the mission's name.

Thousands of years ago, there was a Iligh-Level World named Umbrasol. The beings of Umbrasol were feared; even amongst the High-Level Worlds, it was quite strong. Not many forces could go against this world at that time.
Most beings of Umbrasol were born with Eclipse Bone Physique, a physique that makes it easier for them to access the Energy of Death.
These beings studied Essence of Death, mastering the Laws related to Death, becoming a force so strong that even the four Supreme Worlds recognized them for their strength.
However, these beings didn't stop.
Their goal was much higher than anyone thought; they wanted to be recognized as the Fifth Supreme World.
Of course, since their world's energy was limited, this wasn't possible, but not giving up, they came up with a method.
Gathering Master Craftsmen from all over the Universe, they invented an Artifact called Necrocore- a Core that could store the Energy of Death.
The Energy of Death could be gathered from deaths. If there were enough deaths, they could gather any amount of energy they wanted.
Or at least that is what they thought.
So they started artificially gathering the Energy of Death, storing it inside the Core, and once they collected enough, they wanted their world to use that energy to upgrade itself.
Of course, the plan itself would take millions of years, however, it didn't matter.
Everything was going fine, the beings of Umbrasol gathered more and more energy, but then, something happened.

The energy they had been gathering for hundreds of thousands of years started leaking. The beings of Umbrasol tried to control it, but the energy was much more rampant than they expected. The amount of energy gathered was so high that even the beings who excelled in Death couldn't control it anymore.

The energy was released, surrounding the entirety of Umbrasol, devouring all the Life Force present in that place. Within a few days, Umbrasol-a once-thriving world-became a barren place with no living entity inside

Everyone was killed; only the strongest being, their Leader, managed to leave. However, even his Life Force was devoured, and he didn't have long to live. In his last moments, he explained the tragedy to his allies and passed.

At first, not many cared. After all, Umbrasol was already destroyed; even if they were allies, there was no point caring about an ally who was already dead, and they were the ones who brought it upon themselves in the first place.
However, after some time, the Death Energy that had surrounded Umbrasol started getting stronger.

It was to the point where it started leaking out, leaving Umbrasol's boundaries. At first, the Universal Energy surrounding Umbrasol managed to stop it. However, the ever-growing Death Energy couldn't be stopped.
It started traveling through the Universe, reaching nearby worlds, devouring all the life it could find, and strengthening itself in the process.
Just like that, more and more worlds were devoured, sent to ruin.
Now, it wasn't just Umbrasol's problem; it had turned into a Universal Threat.
The Supreme Worlds had to intervene.
However, Death Energy was something not many beings understood; it had the power to kill even the immortals, so even the Supreme Worlds had to tread carefully.
In the end, the four Supreme Worlds decided that it was better to devour the world. Once Umbrasol, the source of the rampant Death Energy, disappeared, the Death Energy would obviously disappear
as well.
So they sent their armies to conquer the world. Of course, since it was only just an empty world, one simply had to go there, find the World's Core, and devour it.
It sounded simple enough.
However...
The army sent by the Four Supreme Worlds didn't return.
Another army was sent, but their fate was the same.
More and more armies were sent, with each army stronger than before-even Eternals were sent. It was then,

The Eternal who was sent in the most recent conquest returned, his face pale, body filled with Death Energy. His organs were giving out, his blood had diluted, his Life Force was depleted. Honestly, not even a High-Level World would have enough resources to save him, but fortunately, he was from a Supreme-Level World, and he also had a bit of a background, so he was saved.
Well... at least his life was prolonged for ten more years..."
"Ten years?"
"He passed away after that; the Death Energy had seeped too deep inside his body, there was no way
to save him."
"Even an Eternal failed...?"
Riona couldn't believe it.
How much stronger was an Eternal compared to them?
He was three Phases above them!
That being could kill the likes of them with a snap of his finger!
"Why do you think we abandoned this mission?"
The Lion Head snorted.
Nux, however, narrowed his eyes.
"If an Eternal failed, what even gave you the confidence that your Mercenaries could do something
about it?
There must be something that made you think you could do it, no?"
"I knew you weren't simple.
The Lion Head laughed.
"We took the mission because of the information he passed before he died!

chapters.title: Chapter 1718 Wraiths
paragraphs: "We took the mission because of the information he passed before he died!
The Lion Head, Simba, spoke.
Nux narrowed his eyes, waiting for the man to continue.
"The Death Energy that had surrounded Umbrasol and is now leaking out, we call it the Reaper's Veil. The Reaper's Veil has become a threat to the surrounding worlds.
For now, the Supreme Worlds have used their powers to teleport Umbrasol extremely far away, so it is not very dangerous for now, however, it is definitely not a threat we can ignore.

If not today, then in a few million or a billion years, when the Death Energy from the Reaper's Veil grows strong enough to reach here without being completely destroyed by the Universal Energy in space, we won't be able to handle it.
This is also the reason why this mission isn't closed or taken down despite so many failed attempts."
"What about the Supreme Worlds? Have they given up? Why didn't they solve the problem directly instead of delaying it?
They sent an Eternal, why not send an Infinity? I'm sure an Infinity Level Being would be able to deal with the problem!"
Hearing Nux's words, Simba just stared at him with a dumbfounded look on his face. Then, he laughed out loud.
"I guess people who do not know much would indeed think like that."
Nux frowned.
"Do you think Infinity Level Beings just lay around all over the place?
They are the Peak Existences in the entire Universe. Each one of them has power so unfathomable that no one in the entire Universe would even think about going against them.

Even if they are from the Supreme World, mobilizing an Infinity Level Being isn't easy. Infinities are either Progenitors of those Worlds or beings strong enough to stand toe to toe with the Progenitors.
Also, this isn't a problem that could be solved by a stronger cultivator.
This is also the reason why people like us dared to touch this mission!"
"The information..."
Nux muttered, and Simba nodded.
Then, he waved his hand, and suddenly, a projection of a world covered with black energy appeared right in front of Nux and Simba.
"This is Umbrasol. The Black Energy surrounding it is the Reaper's Veil. See it leaking out? This shows that the entirety of the world is filled with this energy.
According to the mission, you are supposed to enter this world.
Of course, no being other than those who have power over Death can do that. For others, just. entering this world is a death sentence."
Simba stared at Nux.
Nux raised his hand, and suddenly, Black Mist came out. The Mist moved toward a nearby plant, and in an instant. its leaves dried out.
Seeing that, Simba nodded.
Nux nodded back.
Yes, it was the Devouring Mist.

Nux knew that Devouring Mist wasn't exactly the Energy of Death. Although Acliana did think Devouring Mist was related to the Primordial Energy of Death since the Black Hole devoured it, after devouring all the worlds and absorbing all the knowledge, Nux realized that instead of Primordial Energy of Death, Devouring Mist represented Primordial Energy of Destruction.
Yes, the two of them had similar properties, but they were essentially different.
Of course, normal people didn't know that. Heck, many didn't even know about Primordial Energies in general.
This was the reason why Simba thought whatever he used was related to Death. If even someone like Acliana made a mistake, then Simba making the same mistake wasn't out of the ordinary.
Of course, that helped Nux, since he didn't have a power directly related to Death, Devouring Mist would do.
For now, Nux decided to focus on the projection.
They were getting closer and closer to the Reaper's Veil, before finally, they entered Umbrasol.
"Once you enter Umbrasol, there are a few things you need to be aware of.
Simba spoke as suddenly, a Black Tornado could be seen in the projection, and it wasn't just one; there were many of them all over the place.

"We call it a Deathstorm. There are a lot of these all over, just like you see here. You can still avoid the Reaper's Veil because you have some power over Death. However, the Deathstorms are different.
No matter what sort of power you have, the moment you are close to it, it doesn't matter how strong you are, it is over!
Simba spoke, and suddenly, the projection showed a being who couldn't avoid the Deathstorm in time. His body was instantly devoured, never to be seen again.
Nux raised his eyebrow.
"Another thing is that inside Umbrasol, all other powers that are not related to Death are suppressed and cannot be used."
"What?"
Nux blinked in surprise.
"Yes, inside, you can only use that Mist you showed me!
"The next thing!
"There's more?"
Nux questioned.

"Of course. If it was just that, the Mission wouldn't be a Black Mission: Simba smiled mysteriously. Then suddenly, the projection showed a Semi-Corporeal being. Its body shifted between mist and solid matter, and it had a ghostly, spectral appearance that was difficult to focus on. Its skin appeared ashen and decaying, with some of it hanging down. It wore a black-colored cloak with a hood that. covered most of its face with darkness, making none of its features visible. The only thing that could be seen were its faintly glowing eerie eyes that exuded an unsettling stillness.
"These are wraiths"
Simba spoke.
"These beings are the reason this mission is so dangerous.
For Wraiths to be formed, two things are required:
Death Energy and a Soul.
Umbrasol has almost endless Death Energy, so that was never the problem. As for the other one..."
"We're sending it right to them!
Nux spoke, understanding what Simba was trying to say.
Simba stared at Nux and nodded.
"If the people sent there die, they are turned into Wraiths.
So far, almost 90,000 beings have been sent to Umbrasol.
"So that means there are 90,000 Wraiths there...?"
"Yes, but that's not all.
Numbers wouldn't matter if one is strong enough. The problem is..."

Simba spoke.
"These beings are the reason this mission is so dangerous.
For Wraiths to be formed, two things are required:
Death Energy and a Soul.
Umbrasol has almost endless Death Energy, so that was never the problem.
As for the other one..."
"We're sending it right to them!
Nux spoke, understanding what Simba was trying to say.
Simba stared at Nux and nodded.
"If the people sent there die, they are turned into Wraiths.
So far, almost 90,000 beings have been sent to Umbrasol.
"So that means there are 90,000 Wraiths there...?"
"Yes, but that's not all.
Numbers wouldn't matter if one is strong enough.
The problem is..."

chapters.title: Chapter 1719 90,000 Sovereigns.
paragraphs: "So that means there are 90,000 Wraiths there...?"
"Yes, but that is not it. Numbers wouldn't matter if one is strong enough. The problem is..."
Simba turned silent, which annoyed Nux.
"What is it?" he questioned in an irritated voice.
"How strong do you think these Wraiths are?"
Simba questioned, and suddenly, Nux turned silent.
If these beings were made from Death Energy and Soul, then their strength should depend on these two things.
Since the Death Energy in Umbrasol is endless, that shouldn't be the factor. Then the only factor left. is... Soul.

There was a high probability that a Wraith formed is as strong as the Soul it was formed with. However, if that was the case, a Middle-Level World like Nexus shouldn't be dealing with this mission. After all, even if the Eternal that was sent came back, the Transcendents didn't, meaning that there should be more than a few Transcendent-level Wraiths there. There is no way Nexus, a Middle-Level World, is strong enough to send a few Transcendent-level beings to deal with the problem.

That meant the Wraiths' strength depended on something else... something that gave beings of Nexus a ray of hope, making them think that it might be possible to complete it. And at the same time, it is also something strong enough to make even the Supreme World back away.
"Wraiths are as strong as the beings who enter Umbrasol.
Nux spoke, and Simba, who heard those words, smiled as he raised his eyebrows in surprise.
"I didn't think you would guess that'
"Endless energy is available. Since the Wraiths are formed from the Soul, their power should depend on the strongest living soul present in the place," Nux spoke.
"Well, we still do not know what sort of principle works here! Simba replied.

Nux nodded. He, however, could already make a guess. As someone who knew how energies and worlds worked, it was easier for him to understand things normal people couldn't comprehend. The Wraiths are beings created by Umbrasol. It must have sensed that the beings who come in wish to devour it, so it responds by creating artificial protectors. This means that these Wraiths do not roam around all the time; they are only formed when intruders come. This is why their strength is also limited to the amount of Life Energy released by the being who entered.
"Not that it matters.
What matters is the fact that once you enter, you need to face 90,000 Wraiths,

90,000 Sovereigns who are experts in using Death Energy and have abilities you probably have never seen before, once you deal with them or either avoid them, you need to enter the Heart of Umbrasol and devour it.
More rewards will be given if you can also bring back the Necrostone, but of course, extra rewards can only be talked about once the actual mission is completed.
Simba joked.
"So this is why the Supreme Worlds abandoned that place," Nux spoke, and Simba nodded.
"If they sent an Infinity Level Being, they would need to face 90,000 Infinity level beings. It would be a disaster!"
Simba spoke.

Nux, however, inwardly shook his head. If Infinity-level beings were anywhere near the level of that monster, he highly doubted the 'endless' Death Energy would be enough to recreate 90,000 of them. Of course, the mission was still dangerous, and yes, it was much better for a weaker-level cultivator to go and try to complete this mission.
"Anyways, are you satisfied now? Since I told you everything, you can leave. As much as I like talking to someone as clever as you, I have other important things to do"
Simba waved his hand, wanting to send Nux away.
"I'll do it."
Suddenly, Nux spoke up.
"I said I will take this mission."
Nux repeated, and Simba couldn't believe what he just heard.
"Have you... lost your mind?"
Simba questioned.
"I have not.

"... You do realize you need to face 90,000 Sovereign-level beings at the same time while you avoid the Deathstroms, and all your abilities other than the ones that are related to Death Energy will not work.
It would be an understatement to say that you will be at a disadvantage.

Even if you bring an army of Sovereigns to that place, you cannot possibly find more than 90,000 Sovereigns who have the Power over Death and can enter the Reaper's Veil. We have searched all over the Universe; there is no other World that deals with the Power of Death.
Heck, I doubt even Umbrasol had more than 90,000 Sovereigns when it was at its peak!
Simba couldn't believe it.
"You don't have to worry. Since I said I will do it, I will!
"You were just talking about how there is a difference between confidence and plain arrogance!"
Simba spoke, and Nux smiled.
"Don't worry. My statement comes from my confidence, not arrogance.
You just need to prepare for all the fame your Fortune's Call would receive when its mercenary clears the fearsome Black Mission abandoned by all.
Of course, don't forget to make me a Star Mercenary once I return"
Nux chuckled.
Simba was silent.
Nux, on the other hand, grabbed the mission papers, but before he could move, Simba placed his
hand over the papers and,
"I cannot allow that," he spoke.
"Why do people of this Mercenary Hall keep making decisions in my stead?"
Nux frowned.

"You do realize I can get this mission from any other Mercenary Hall, correct? You people will just be losing a rising Star Mercenary that is probably the best one you have ever seen. This decision has no gain and a lot to lose, trust me."
"Let's do it this way. Pass my test; if you can, you can take this mission!
"Why would I do that? I have nothing to ga-"
"If you win, I will show you a recording!
"Recording?"
"It is something we got our hands on after quite a lot of effort. It is the fight Lord Arvin and his men
had with the Wraiths. You will find quite a lot about the Wraiths' abilities if you see it, and I can
assure you, you won't find this recording anywhere else throughout Nexus.
"What is the test?"
Nux questioned, and Simba smiled.

chapters.title: Chapter 1720 Mission: Show your Might!
paragraphs: "Hey, hey, did you register for that mission?"
It seemed like an incomplete question.
'That' mission?
What in the hell does that even mean? What mission are you talking about? Every mission has a name; why not mention the name directly?
This should be a normal response to this question.
However, This time, it was different.
"Are you kidding me? Of course I did. Ten thousand Nexus Credits for defeating a single Sovereign in a one-on-one battle? It couldn't be any simpler. I'd be a fool if I didn't register!"
Another man with a muscular build answered with a big smile on his face.

"Hahaha~ You are the fifteenth person who said the same thing. I guess quite a lot of people have registered for the mission. Even mercenaries who don't usually come to Fortune's Call are accepting this mission. I heard some even came from another Mercenary World. I wonder who will get the final reward."
"Who else? The one who defeats the opponent."
"And if that man is defeated in the first round?"
"Then others can only sigh and feel bad about the missed opportunity."
"I guess the one who goes first will be the lucky one."

"If you think about it, it won't be that simple. Giving ten thousand Nexus Credits to defeat just one Sovereign—no fool would throw their money away like that. If they're doing so, then there must be a catch. That Sovereign must be strong. So the one who faces him first has a higher chance of losing, and as he gets weaker, those fighting later have a better chance of winning."
"But that's quite risky too, isn't it? The later you appear, the higher the chances of the opponent losing before you even get your chance."

"Hahaha! That is what makes all of this so interesting, isn't it? Why do you think they're auctioning the battle order two days later? It's highly likely that this mission is nothing but a form of business. Because of the huge reward, every Sovereign would want to participate. However, since the order they fight in is so important, it wouldn't be surprising if mercenaries even pay a thousand Nexus Credits just to get the spot they desire.
If they find even ten such mercenaries, the rest they earn will be pure profit. It's quite ingenious."
"Now that you say it like that... that does seem possible.
So all of this is just a scam?"

"Not really. They will give ten thousand credits to the one who wins; the rest will just be making losses. It's not a scam; it just prevents the losers from joining and ruining the fun. If you don't have enough decisiveness to choose the order you want to fight in and don't believe you can defeat your opponent, then you better not join and waste others' time."
"So does this mean you are going to participate in the auction?"
"Of course."
"So what spot are you going to bid for?"
"The third one."
"Ehh? You decided that pretty fast."
"Of course. I can't miss the opportunity to make easy money."
The man laughed, his eyes filled with desire and greed.
It wasn't just him or the person talking to him; all Sovereigns throughout Nexus were talking about this new mission Fortune's Call posted just a while ago.
Mission: Show your Might!
Mission Description: Defeat Nux Leander, a Sovereign-Level Being, in a one-on-one battle, inside the Arena. (Arena Rules apply)
Rewards: Ten Thousand Nexus Credits.
Restrictions: Only Sovereigns can join.
Failure Penalty: None.

It was one of the missions with the shortest description. Usually, that would make many raise eyebrows, since a short description meant a lack of information. But this time, that didn't matter; just the reward and failure penalty section made people's eyes shine.

Even Special Missions didn't have such rewards! All the Sovereign Stage Mercenaries, who were used to earning five hundred to seven hundred Nexus Credits per mission, couldn't hide their greed when they saw the mission.
Chaos spread all over Nexus as the news spread like fire. More and more mercenaries rushed towards Fortune's Call; even beings from other Mercenary Worlds rushed in.
It was quite surprising and, for the first time in a long while, the Fortune's Call building was fully jammed up with thousands of Sovereigns lining up, wanting to register for the Mission.
The employees working in Fortune's Call couldn't catch a break; some even cursed the person who posted this mission.
As for the person who was the cause of all this chaos,
Well, he was lying on his bed, with an extremely beautiful woman in his arms, without a care in the world.
"It has become quite chaotic."
Riona chuckled as she heard all the noise outside. Even here, at an inn quite far from the Fortune's Call building, she could hear people talking about the mission posted.
"I have no clue why he's doing this. He's just delaying everything." Nux complained.

Of course, his tone didn't seem full of dissatisfaction since his head was currently nestled under Riona's cleavage. His hands didn't settle, constantly caressing Riona's body. Riona, of course, enjoyed her husband's embrace and replied.
"Well, we do need the recording he has."
"He should have just given it to me. Why make it so complicated?"
"Who knows? Maybe he's just trying to buy time? Or maybe he doesn't actually want you to take this mission."
What Riona said indeed made a lot of sense. After all, Simba's test was truly absurd. He wanted Nux to face all the Sovereigns who took this mission, and the number was already in the thousands.
"Well, I'm going to face more than 90,000 Divines in Umbrasol under harsh conditions, so if I can't even deal with this, I wouldn't be qualified enough to take the mission."
"Well, I guess Fortune's Call's reputation is at stake in some way or another.
I doubt they can recklessly send more people there, since the more people they send, the higher the number of enemies others have to face, and the more difficult the mission would become."
Riona nodded.
And Nux just shrugged as he then rolled over on top of Riona and said,
"Not that any of it matters.
I just need to wait for 5 days as he said.
Then, once I sweep all of them,
We'll leave for the mission."

chapters.title: Chapter 1721 The wife who is loved the most.
paragraphs: "Ho ho, would you look at that? How long has it been since the Arena was so full of life? And why would it not be? Fortune's Call has taken all of Nexus by surprise with the recent mission they posted! Even we, at the Arena, were surprised when they came to us to arrange all this! It was only five days, but our excitement was so high that even five days felt like five hundred years! Now, however, the wait is over! So, Mercenaries! Are you ready for today's show!?" A beautiful woman, standing in the middle of the stage, questioned out loud. Her voice echoed throughout the Arena. "YEAHHHHH!!" The crowd cheered. The stadium, capable of holding more than two hundred thousand beings, was filled to the brim. Usually, not even 20% of this stadium is filled unless it's some sort of special event. Today, however, things were different. A mission that attracted the attention of mercenaries all over Nexus. A mission with a grand reward of 10,000 Nexus Credits without any failure penalties whatsoever. Who would possibly want to miss this mission? "Since today's event might last for a long time, all other battles have been rescheduled, so without having to wait any further, we can jump directly to our main event!!" The woman announced. "YEAHHHHHH!!!" Once again, the crowd cheered. The woman waited for the crowd to settle down. It had been a while since she had seen such a large crowd, so she was enjoying the moment and taking her time. When she was satisfied, she continued, "A total of 20,530 Sovereigns have registered for the Mission 'Show Your Might!', so the event might last a few days! Of course, until then, refreshments will be provided by the Arena, so you can enjoy the show without worrying about anything! Because of the Auction held by Fortune's Call Mercenary Hall, we already have the order of the fights ready. The battles will only end once Nux Leander loses. Nux Leander will not be given any rest between battles and will need to face more than twenty thousand opponents one by one. How long do you think our champion will last!? If you think your predictions are right, you can also test your observational skills at our bidding center and earn some money! As they say, it's only interesting when money is involved! Biddings are open for all, and your personal information will be kept hidden! So go bid now! And while you do so, I shall call our Champion, the one who dared to stand against the entire world, the one who has blessed us with such a grand event, The Bravest of all Sovereigns, Nux Leander!!" The crowd cheered. Of course, while quite a few people supported Nux and were impressed by his boldness, most were disdainful. Some even pitied the fool who would lose his life today. Of course, the man in question didn't care. He simply stepped into the Arena, and as he did, more cheers erupted, especially from the fairer gender. Even in a completely new world with different races and beauty standards, he still attracted the attention of the fairer sex, something the rougher sex didn't like. While the women cheered for him and even showed their worries, the men shouted, screaming at the participants to kill Nux. The excitement in the Arena was sky-high, and not wishing to lose this chance, the announcer continued, "Surprised, aren't you? I didn't know our champion was such a treat to the eyes before I met him. Now, let's call the first participant of today's event, the first being to fight Nux Leander, someone most of you probably know: a mercenary known for his efficiency and high completion rate, a mercenary who is not only strong, decisive, and intelligent, but also ruthless and tactical when needed. One of the finest Assassins of Nexus, Leader of the Solitude Mercenary Group, one of the best Nyklian, known as dangerous assassins feared all over the universe, Nathan Nyks!" As the woman announced, a being with a humanoid but slightly smaller and leaner figure, with elongated limbs and sleek, shadow-hued skin, walked in. His skin had a faint sheen, appearing almost translucent, as if it could adapt to the environment's colors, giving the being a natural camouflage. Nathan's eyes were large, with pupils that could dilate fully to capture any available light, making him adept in total darkness. Nux could also see retractable claws at his fingertips, likely useful for silent and quick kills. "Nathan! He came!" "He really did! I thought he was gone away on a mission!" "Then isn't the event as good as over?" "I pity that Human now..." "A Human against a Nyklian in a one-on-one duel... it's not even fair at this point." "I heard Nathan bid 2,500 Nexus Credit Points to fight first." "2,500? That's a big number. I guess once he wins, he'll get four times the amount he paid, so it makes sense." "Indeed. The order of bidding started from the furthest, all the way to the first one, and from what my friend told me, Nathan didn't bid for any other spot except the first." "Hahaha! How bold of him! It's quite unlike his usual meticulous attitude." "I guess he's that confident." "Heh." "This battle is as good as over." "Why do you think I bet that this Human wouldn't even last one round? I knew the first one to fight was Nathan." One laughed. "You knew!?" "Didn't I tell you my friend was at the auction?" "Why didn't you tell me!? I would have made the bet as well!" "The more people bet on the same thing as I do, the less money I'll win." The man shrugged. "Don't blame me; it's pure business." "You!!" As the people continued to talk about it, in the bidding office, something shocking was happening. "W-What did you say?" The Office Head, who looked like a goblin, stared at the beautiful woman standing in front of him with a shocked look on his face. "Are you not going to accept the bet?" The woman frowned. "Are you sure you want to bet on it?" "Yes, Nux Leander wins all the fights. I bet 10,000 Nexus Credit Points on it. The ratio is 1:100, correct? A million Credits should last for a while." "I-I usually don't say this, but don't get lost in your greed." The Head spoke, but the woman continued to stare at him without saying anything. In the end, the Head just sighed and said, "Well, if you're that eager to lose your money, I won't stop you. What name should I use while I register your bid?" "Riona Leander." sentences.text: "Ho ho, would you look at that?
How long has it been since the Arena was so full of life?
And why would it not be?
Fortune's Call has taken all of Nexus by surprise with the recent mission they posted!
Even we, at the Arena, were surprised when they came to us to arrange all this!
It was only five days, but our excitement was so high that even five days felt like five hundred years!
Now, however, the wait is over!
So, Mercenaries!
Are you ready for today's show!?" A beautiful woman, standing in the middle of the stage, questioned out loud.
Her voice echoed throughout the Arena.
"YEAHHHHH!!" The crowd cheered.
The stadium, capable of holding more than two hundred thousand beings, was filled to the brim.
Usually, not even 20% of this stadium is filled unless it's some sort of special event.
Today, however, things were different.
A mission that attracted the attention of mercenaries all over Nexus.
A mission with a grand reward of 10,000 Nexus Credits without any failure penalties whatsoever.
Who would possibly want to miss this mission?
"Since today's event might last for a long time, all other battles have been rescheduled, so without having to wait any further, we can jump directly to our main event!!" The woman announced.
"YEAHHHHHH!!!" Once again, the crowd cheered.
The woman waited for the crowd to settle down.
It had been a while since she had seen such a large crowd, so she was enjoying the moment and taking her time.
When she was satisfied, she continued, "A total of 20,530 Sovereigns have registered for the Mission 'Show Your Might!', so the event might last a few days!
Of course, until then, refreshments will be provided by the Arena, so you can enjoy the show without worrying about anything!
Because of the Auction held by Fortune's Call Mercenary Hall, we already have the order of the fights ready.
The battles will only end once Nux Leander loses.
Nux Leander will not be given any rest between battles and will need to face more than twenty thousand opponents one by one.
How long do you think our champion will last!?
If you think your predictions are right, you can also test your observational skills at our bidding center and earn some money!
As they say, it's only interesting when money is involved!
Biddings are open for all, and your personal information will be kept hidden!
So go bid now!

And while you do so, I shall call our Champion, the one who dared to stand against the entire world, the one who has blessed us with such a grand event, The Bravest of all Sovereigns, Nux Leander!!" The crowd cheered.
Of course, while quite a few people supported Nux and were impressed by his boldness, most were disdainful.
Some even pitied the fool who would lose his life today.
Of course, the man in question didn't care.
He simply stepped into the Arena, and as he did, more cheers erupted, especially from the fairer gender.
Even in a completely new world with different races and beauty standards, he still attracted the attention of the fairer sex, something the rougher sex didn't like.
While the women cheered for him and even showed their worries, the men shouted, screaming at the participants to kill Nux.
The excitement in the Arena was sky-high, and not wishing to lose this chance, the announcer continued, "Surprised, aren't you?
I didn't know our champion was such a treat to the eyes before I met him.

Now, let's call the first participant of today's event, the first being to fight Nux Leander, someone most of you probably know: a mercenary known for his efficiency and high completion rate, a mercenary who is not only strong, decisive, and intelligent, but also ruthless and tactical when needed.

One of the finest Assassins of Nexus, Leader of the Solitude Mercenary Group, one of the best Nyklian, known as dangerous assassins feared all over the universe, Nathan Nyks!" As the woman announced, a being with a humanoid but slightly smaller and leaner figure, with elongated limbs and sleek, shadow-hued skin, walked in.
His skin had a faint sheen, appearing almost translucent, as if it could adapt to the environment's colors, giving the being a natural camouflage.
Nathan's eyes were large, with pupils that could dilate fully to capture any available light, making him adept in total darkness.
Nux could also see retractable claws at his fingertips, likely useful for silent and quick kills.
"Nathan!
He came!" "He really did!

I thought he was gone away on a mission!" "Then isn't the event as good as over?" "I pity that Human now..." "A Human against a Nyklian in a one-on-one duel... it's not even fair at this point." "I heard Nathan bid 2,500 Nexus Credit Points to fight first." "2,500?
That's a big number.
I guess once he wins, he'll get four times the amount he paid, so it makes sense." "Indeed.

How bold of him!
It's quite unlike his usual meticulous attitude." "I guess he's that confident." "Heh." "This battle is as good as over." "Why do you think I bet that this Human wouldn't even last one round?
I knew the first one to fight was Nathan." One laughed.
"You knew!?" "Didn't I tell you my friend was at the auction?" "Why didn't you tell me!?

I bet 10,000 Nexus Credit Points on it.
The ratio is 1:100, correct?
A million Credits should last for a while." "I-I usually don't say this, but don't get lost in your greed." The Head spoke, but the woman continued to stare at him without saying anything.

Riona smiled.
"I will be back soon." She spoke.
"You won't have to; it's not like you're going to win."

chapters.title: Chapter 1722 It’ll take too long like this.
paragraphs: "I will be back soon." She spoke. "You won't have to, it is not like you are going to win." At those words, Riona just chuckled as she left the room. 'What a strange woman.' The Office Head thought inwardly. Then, his focus shifted to the battle that could be seen from the window of his office. Indeed, he had the elite view of the battle, one of the perks of working at Arena. "YEAAHHHHHHH!!! NATHAN!!! KILL HIM!!" "NO! Don't kill him! Just tire him out! I need to win some money!"

"Shut the hell up!" "You!!" The instant Nathan stepped in, the crowd was excited, it was a much grander welcome than what Nux received. Nux could sense not even a single being was on his side and everyone seemed to know who this Nathan dude was. 'I guess he is a big shot.' Nux thought inwardly as he stared at the being in front of him and with just one look, he could tell, he was definitely different from other scrubs he had faced here before. He was strong. Nux narrowed his eyes, preparing himself for the battle. Nathan on the other hand, seemed laid back. He was confident in his skills. Seeing that the two fighters were ready, the announcer flew in the air, her voice was heard throughout the arena and, "So the first battle of today's grand event starts in, Three! Two!

One! Fight!!!" The moment she said those words, Nathan prepared himself, one of his abilities allowed him to step out of the physical plane, making him much lighter than normal and almost tripling his speed, making him pretty much invisible to any Sovereign since he was already quite fast for a Sovereign and with his boosted speed, he was no different than a ghost. The battle plan was simple, he would step out of the physical plane, with his increased speed, he would get to Nux, then using his claws that are laced with lethal poison, he would attack Nux and the battle would end. Yes, that is just it. There was no need to plan any further. In a one-on-one battle against an enemy who most probably had no clue about him and his abilities, it was a sure-shot plan, heck, even if the enemy knew about him, there was nothing he could do. He couldn't react to his speed, neither could he resist the poison.

It was a strategy that he had used almost his entire life, a sure shot kill, a reliable combo that never fails. However, Today, it was different. Just before Nathan could use his ability, Nux appeared in front of him and, "No hard feelings." "Wh-" Before Nathan could react, he felt something grabbing his face, in an instant, his world flipped over, his head crashed on the ground, the impact was so large that his skull cracked, he wanted to cough blood but with his mouth covered with Nux's palm, he could only chock in his own blood, unable to take the impact, his brain sent signals throughout his body and... He lost his consciousness. The battle was over. Nux stood up, then glanced at the Arena floor with an impressed look on his friend, "It didn't break. The material they used is quite good." "..." "..." "..." Dead silence fell all over Arena. Let alone the crowd, even the announcer stared at the sight with absolute disbelief and Nux, who noticed the silence, turned towards the announcer and, "Do I have to kill him to be declared as the winner? I am not sure, but according to the rules, if one is unable to fight, the battle is over, no? There is no need to kill unnecessarily." "R-Right! You are right!
S-So everyone! We have the winner of the first battle! Nux Leander!!!"
The announcer shouted, trying her best to instil excitement into the crowd. The crowd, however, stayed silent. They just couldn't believe what they saw. "H-He won...?"
"N-Nathan l-lost?" This made no sense. Nathan was one of the best mercenaries in Nexus. He was someone who would soon become one of the famed Star Mercenaries.

How could someone like him lose to... someone they didn't even know? The announcer, who noticed the strange atmosphere decided to do something and, "S-Since the first battle is over, the next one is..." The next participant was called. Once again, he was someone most people in the Arena knew, many had even bid on him and he raised the hope of quite a lot of people in the audience, However, "Start!" The moment the announcer announced the start of the match, once again, Nux disappeared from his place, appeared right next to the second participant and, *Bam* Face first into the floor, because of the high impact on the head, the participant passed out. The battle was over. Once again, Nux stood up, staring at Announcer, signalling her to announce the result and call for the next participant. And then, Something the mercenaries of Nexus would never forget in their life happened, One after another, the most popular mercenaries stepped onto the stage, these were mercenaries who had spent around five hundred credit points just to fight Nux and win. Honestly, ever since the start, they never even thought about losing, they were just worried that their turns wouldn't come. Yes, they were that sure of their strength. However, *Bam* *Bam* *Bam* *Bam* The results were all the same. Heads were smashed onto the floor, one after the other, the mercenaries who were so sure of themselves continued to lose, not even one of them was able to use any of their abilities no matter how hard they tried. Nux was simply so fast that he couldn't even react to his movements.

The fastest ones could not avoid him, the strong ones didn't have the chance to show their strength, the durable ones felt their durability and pride shatter into pieces, almost nothing could be done against this monster. *Yawn.* Heck, the man even dared to yawn in the middle of the Arena. Then, with tears welling up in his eyes from the massive yawn, Nux stared at the announcer and, "It will take too long like this, Send all of them at the same time."

chapters.title: Chapter 1723 How funny~
paragraphs: "It will take too long like this, Send all of them at the same time." Nux spoke as he glanced at the announcer with a lazy look on his face. "W-What...?" The announcer stuttered. Nux didn't shout, but because of how the entire Arena was shrouded in silence, every single person heard his arrogant words. Their gazes became dangerous, all of them staring at him as if warning him not to repeat what he said. Of course, Nux didn't care. "It is too boring, Let them all come at the same time, that might make things a little more interesting." "I-I don't think I-I am a-allowed to do t-that." Obviously, the announcer was confused. She looked around, trying to find a superior, not knowing how to react to such a strange request. If it was a normal situation, she would have just treated Nux as some arrogant fool and used his words to rile up the crowd and make the show more exciting. But... What she just saw in the past few minutes was... The announcer was currently looking at the eleventh mercenary who was being taken away by the Healers. He was one of the most well-known mercenaries throughout Nexus; he not only had an excellent track record, he had also won quite a few battles in the Arena, a well-known figure, but... just like the rest, he lost the moment the battle started. He couldn't even resist. Nux was a monster who continuously defeated strong mercenaries one after another, crushing people's hopes under his feet, and he did all that in such a dominating manner that no one could even call him out. The announcer had no clue how to answer this man. "How arrogant! You think the world revolves around you just because you won a few fights!?" However, unlike her, the people in the crowd weren't so calm, especially the ones who had lost their hard-earned money because they bet on his defeat. One of the people who was unable to control his anger lashed out at Nux, and the moment he did, the rest followed. "Exactly! Bring all of them at the same time!? Who do you think you are!?" "He must be using some sort of trickery! I bet it is all planned out! A farce to make us lose our money!" "That's right! This must be something Fortune's Call came up with! This is the reason I don't do business with them anymore!" "I am rethinking my past decisions as well! I guess I should really look into other Mercenary Halls!" As the crowd lashed out, their target shifted from Nux to Fortune's Call. Simba, who was watching all this, had a grave look on his face. He realized he had underestimated Nux's strength, but right now, more than that, he was worried about his reputation. However, before he could say anything, "Heh." Suddenly, someone laughed. A beautiful voice resounded throughout the Arena, and as if a spell was cast, the entire Arena turned silent, their attention turning towards the source of this voice. Then, their eyes fell on a certain black-haired woman with features so beautiful that almost all men could feel their hearts beating loudly. The woman, who was sitting amongst the crowd, continued to chuckle. "How funny." She commented, her voice so beautiful that men present felt a strange force attracting them towards her. Especially the men who were sitting close to her. Some bold ones even tried to make a move, or at least they tried to; however, the moment that thought appeared in their head, it disappeared. They could feel it—a strange intimidation that told them not to do anything foolish. The woman then glanced at the crowd and, "Look at who is talking, People who weren't even bold enough to participate in the event. If all of you are so sure, why don't you join in? If you are so sure that all of this is just an act, enter the stage and fight. If you win, you get 10,000 Nexus Credit Points, but... If you lose, you will lose 1,000 Nexus Credits, after all, you did just try to defame my husband and Fortune's Call." The woman's smile then widened and, "I am sure brave men like you have the balls to back up your claims, no?" The instant she said those words, the crowd went silent. No one dared to step forward. Barely any of them were at the level of the mercenaries who were just defeated; if people who were stronger than them couldn't do anything, what could they do? They only lashed out because they lost money; none of them had the guts to actually go down and face that monster. And Riona, who could see that, laughed. "I thought so." Her laughter echoed through the Arena. The men were ashamed. They wanted to say many things, but they just couldn't. Even the people who didn't say anything felt ashamed; after all, even they didn't have the guts to go down and face Nux. "Now, now, my wife." Suddenly, another voice was heard. The crowd turned towards Nux and saw him smiling. "You shouldn't bully people like this. It is not their fault. I mean, You need to find different ways to feel important when you know you are below average, no?" Nux then laughed. "I heard one of them said that he was going to leave Fortune's Call and do business somewhere else? How funny~ As if we need someone who doesn't even have the balls to participate in a mission that requires him to defeat a single Sovereign who should be tired after so many different Sovereigns. It is honestly entertaining to see people like him." Nux spoke, looking directly at the man who said those words with a smile full of disdain and mockery. He purposely used words that made him look like he was a part of Fortune's Call, not because he wanted their support or something else, but simply because of how Fortune's Call and its workers acted all this while. Sure, they might have poked their noses where they didn't belong by constantly coming up with different ways to try and stop Nux from taking this mission, but in the end, they were only trying to help and guide the 'ignorant man' who had come to them. After all, no sane person would believe that a man they just met had what it took to complete a mission that even the Supreme World failed to complete. In the end, they were only trying to save his life, and it was something Nux appreciated, so he decided not to let this ruin their image. The man Nux called out trembled in anger, but there was nothing he could do. Once he was done dealing with him, Nux glanced at the announcer again. "What are you waiting for? Call all of them together; I don't have all day."

It was Simba.

"The one who wins against you gets 10,000 Nexus Credit Points. If we send all of them together and they win, it would be difficult to divide the credits amongst them all. Most wouldn't even be able to earn back the credits they spent in the auction to buy the battle spot. If they accept your condition, it would be a lose-lose situation for them."
"I mean, it should already be clear that they wouldn't be able to win anyway if things continued the way they are, no?"
Nux questioned.
Then, he came up with a solution,
"How about this?

Send the next hundred of them. If they win, divide the Credit Points according to how much they spent on the auction. The one who bought the spot for a higher price would receive more credits and vice versa.
This way, both parties would get what they want, no?
Here's another deal:
If I lose, and any of the mercenaries think they can defeat me even in a one-on-one battle, once I recover, I will face them again. If they defeat me, I will give them 10,000 Credit Points on my own.
How does that sound?"
Simba stared at Nux for a moment, and then,
"If you are willing to go that far,
Then that can be arranged."
"I also have another condition."
"What is it?"
"If I win against 100 of them, I will face the next 500. Then, I will face 1,000, then 5,000, 10,000, and so on.
And again, if I lose in any of the battles, the mercenaries who aren't satisfied can challenge me to one-on-one battles later!"
"What if you are defeated by more than a few mercenaries?" Simba questioned. "I will pay them all."
Nux replied.
Silence fell over the place.
Crazy.
This man was absolutely crazy.
This was not confidence. It wasn't even arrogance anymore-it was pure craziness. This man had lost his mind.
"Alright then."
Simba, who was also taken aback by Nux's words, finally nodded.
Now, even he wanted to see. He wanted to know how strong Nux actually was. He wanted to know what gave him the confidence to fight so many experienced mercenaries at the same time.
He wanted to see this man's limit.
He signaled his subordinate, then nodded at the announcer.

The announcer, understanding his signal, announced a five-minute break. Five minutes later, when Nux returned to the stage, the next hundred mercenaries were called. Quite a few of them were well-known, some even tried to rile Nux up before the battle, but Nux ignored it all and waited for the announcer to announce the start of the match.
"Now!
The lv100 between Nux Leander and one hundred mercenaries
Starts... now!"
As she announced, Nux disappeared again and appeared next to the weakest of all one hundred mercenaries.
"One."
*Bam*
He spoke as he smashed the man's head to the ground.
Another mercenary standing next to him ruched toward him, ewinging hie eward with
the aim to sever his arm. Nux, however, extended his arm, placed his hand on the mercenary's face, and,
"Two."
*Bam*

With the second one down, three more mercenaries rushed toward him. Nux let his body loose, Zenith Flow was activated, his body moving on its own. The three who attacked him couldn't even touch him, while he used the chance to smash their heads
onto the floor.
"Three, Four, Five."
*Bam* *Bam* *Bam*
While he was busy dealing with five of them, the rest of the mercenaries prepared themselves.
Now, they were no longer just randomly throwing themselves at him. The few seconds Nux took to take out five of them were enough for them to come up with some sort of
counter plan.

Nux was treated like a monster. Tanks came to the front, swordsmen right behind them, distant damage dealers started attacking from afar, while assassins with high damage lowered their presence, ready to strike the moment they found an opening.
It was the most efficient way for a group to deal with a single being while keeping the casualties to a minimum.
A basic but strong strategy that even beings with endless power relied on mobs to avoid being ganged up on like this.
However,
For Nux, things were different.
Yes, this strategy was strong and worked in most cases, but in front of a monster like
him,
It didn't.
Tanks were supposed to take damage. They were supposed to pull aggro while the rest dealt damage to the enemy. However, the key here was that the tanks were supposed
to take damage and resist.
They were supposed to remain standing.
But...
*Bam* *Bam* *Bam* *Bam*
"Six, Seven, Eight, Nine, Ten, Eleven, Twelve, Thirteen..."
One by one, the tanks fell, each with their heads smashed onto the floor. Mind you, these were beings known for their resilience. They had large frames, some
of them were even five to six feet tall, weighing well over five hundred kilograms. Some
of them had abilities like immovability, invincibility, rock skin, and whatnot. Someone like Nux shouldn't even be able to move them, yet...
He simply grabbed their heads and pushed them onto the ground as if they were dolls
waiting to be slaughtered.
And while Nux dealt with the tanks, the swordsmen, who were supposed to attack with their strongest strikes, did what they were expected to.
It was just that none of their attacks could hit Nux.
No matter how fast they were, no matter what abilities they used, no matter where
they targeted, as if every single part of Nux's body had eyes and brains of its own, it
moved, and none of their attacks went through.
The assassins were the same.

It was almost as if their ability to conceal themselves didn't even work, and their doubts only strengthened when suddenly, Nux, who was dealing with tanks, grabbed a supposedly invisible assassin and smashed his face on the floor just because he was
close.
It was almost as if the man himself didn't care whether the enemy was a tank, assassin,
or swordsman. For him, they were all just beings he needed to take down.
And what's worse?
It was the fact that ever since the battle started...
Nux Leander didn't use even a single ability of his own.
Yes,
Whatever he had been doing all this time was all the result of his physical strength
alone.
The man hadn't even used his Law yet.

chapters.title: Chapter 1725 I-I think he is from a Supreme World...
paragraphs: Once again, the entire Arena was silent.
Just when everyone thought that things couldn't be more shocking, this happened.
It was a 1v100.
One man facing a hundred mercenaries who were on a similar level as him. It should have been a one-sided battle, a battle that shouldn't even be happening in the first place.

How could one Sovereign defeat a hundred Sovereigns at the same time? After all, none of these Sovereigns were weak. They were all strong mercenaries with thousands of years of experience under their belts.

Even an Elite Mercenary wouldn't stand a chance in this battle. Heck, let alone an Elite Mercenary, even a Sovereign from a High-Level World would have a difficult time facing a hundred of them at the same time.
But...
The scene that was unfolding was completely out of the expectations of all the viewers. No, that was an understatement.
It would have been unexpected if Nux was able to barely win the battle, but....
Barely?
This monster had shown such a dominant performance that even though the match hadn't ended, every single spectator knew the result.

The tanks and most of the swordsmen were down. The only ones left were a few assassins and distant damage dealers. The hundred-man team was considerably weakened. They had lost more than half of their forces.
As for the opponent, there was not even a single scratch on his body.
And ever since the start of the battle, he had never once shown any form of hurry. This bastard was walking around the battlefield leisurely!!
It was as if his 'opponents' didn't even matter. It felt like they were mere bugs he encountered during his 'walk,' and he swatted them away since they got in his way.
The damage dealers, who had used all sorts of spells and ultimate abilities to attack him from afar, couldn't do anything.
Every time they attacked, he avoided the strongest of attacks and... simply blocked the rest with his bare hands.
It was a dominant show where even the mercenaries could see their end was near and had pretty much given up on any hopes of victory.
At the same time, they had fallen into absolute despair.
The enemy was simply too strong.
"J-Just what in the hell is he?"
One of the spectators questioned. The entire Arena was so silent that his voice echoed throughout the space.
"I-I think he is from a Supreme World..."
"B-But why would someone from a Supreme World be here...?"
"Why are you asking me?"
"Even if he is from a Supreme World... are all of them... so monstrous? I mean, I am sure they can also defeat a hundred Sovereigns on their own...
But... to do it like this...?
Just what sort of Law is he using?
Is it Absolute Strength? Absolute Dodging? Absolute Speed? Or Absolute Defense? What the hell is it?
How is he able to crush all his opponents like that?"

More and more questions arose as people started guessing what sort of Law this monster had formed. Because the topic seemed interesting, more and more people started joining in and started listing out their guesses.

Of course, not a single one of them mentioned a Law that was not Absolute. With a performance so dominant, it was already assumed that whatever Law it was, it was an Absolute. They just needed to guess what it was.
It was a new form of game for the spectators.
Or...
At least for the weak spectators.
However, not all spectators were weak.

Most of the time, the Arena audience consisted mostly of Sovereigns and beings at a lower level than that. After all, Primordials and above were either Elite Mercenaries who were always on missions or held important positions throughout Nexus. People like them didn't find joy in watching subpar battles. Most of the time, they only visited the Arena when two Primordials fought, which was an extremely rare. occurrence since beings at those levels would rather solve problems on their own than become someone else's source of entertainment. They had their pride and wouldn't lower themselves to mere stage performers.
Because of that, the Arena was mostly a place where Sovereigns and weaker beings gathered. Even if there was a so-called 'Special Event, most spectators were still at that level.
However, there were always exceptions.
The bored Primordials who had nothing to do, Primordials who were tasked to watch over the event, and even Simba, the Primordial who set all this up in the first place-
All these Primordials were here, and...
Unlike the rest of the weaklings present here,
They could see it.
They could tell that while others were guessing what Law he was using to win his battle in such a dominant manner, in reality, Nux Leander wasn't using any Law at all.
All of this was...
Pure Physical Strength.
The Primordials were silent.

Even though they were dispersed throughout the battlefield, all of them stared at each other. The expressions on everyone's faces were all the communication they needed. The Primordials gulped. After all... if this man alone was so strong... the force backing him up would-
Was it really a Supreme World?
But...
Were there such monsters even in Supreme Worlds...?
'No, if it is a Supreme World... then it is possible,' Simba thought inwardly. Then, his
eyes shined.
'If it is him...
Then it might be possible!
Now Simba didn't know why someone like Nux came to his Mercenary Hall, but it didn't matter. Right now, he would treat Nux just like Nux wanted him to, like a
mercenary.
Yes, he would feign ignorance and let all of this go.
And it wasn't just him; all Primordials present came to the same conclusion. There was no point in involving themselves with something that was clearly out of their scope.
*Bam*
And while the Primordials came to this conclusion, Nux slammed the last head into the
floor. Then, he stared at the announcer.
"It will be five hundred of them now, correct?"
The announcer, who was brought out of her reverie with that question, stuttered,
even losing her balance for a moment. She then finally collected herself and said,
"Y-Yes, that is correct. L-Let me announ-"
However, before the woman could complete,
"Wait."
Simba called out.
